There’s a lot happening in Washington right now. We’re fighting to secure the border. We’re working to keep taxes low**** for Kansas families and seniors. We’re standing up for farmers and ranchers, defending our constitutional freedoms, supporting law enforcement, and making sure rural America always has a strong voice.
**The stakes are high.**

Democrats continue pushing bigger government, reckless spending, and policies that make life harder for working families. **We’re pushing back every day — but winning these fights takes more than strong conservative leadership. It takes grassroots support.**

Friend, Tennessee families can’t afford to wait another four years for their governor to to _“study the issue”_ or _“explore solutions.”_ **People need a Governor who has a plan _right now._** That’s why Jerri Green has a real **Day One plan** focused on immediate action to lower costs, protect freedoms, and put working families first from the moment she takes office. **Here’s what Jerri will do on**** _Day One_********as your Governor:**
* **Deliver Housing Relief** by using $10 million in TANF funding to waive security deposits and expand affordable housing access for more than 100,000 Tennessee families.
* **Provide Childcare for All** by using $50 million in TANF funding to eliminate the childcare waitlist so no parent has to choose between earning a paycheck and caring for their child.
* **End Medical Debt **by using $10 million in TANF funding to buy up and erase predatory medical debt for more than 100,000 Tennesseans.
* **Protect Reproductive Freedom** by signing an Executive Order ensuring doctors can provide women’s healthcare without fear of prosecution or prison.
* **Stop ICE Cooperation** by ending cooperation between the Tennessee Highway Patrol and ICE to protect immigrant families from state-sponsored harassment.
* **Restore Expert Leadership **by appointing leaders who actually understand the jobs they are being asked to do — educators leading education, scientists leading public health, and constitutional experts serving as Attorney General.
* **Tear up private prison contracts with CoreCivic** and **break up Ballad Health’s state-protected monopoly** in East Tennessee.
* **Keep TVA Public** by signing an Executive Order affirming that the Tennessee Valley Authority belongs to the people of Tennessee — not private corporations seeking profit.

__**This is what leadership looks like.**__ Not optics over substance. body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Voter registration is a core part of how we fight back against suppression, folks.
How do we do it? We maximize your impact by focusing on the underserved and ignored portions of eligible voters. The unregistered, eligible citizens. Previous voters who let their registration lapse. Anyone who feels disregarded and disconnected from the political process.
Why them? Candidates and their political campaigns target those most likely to turn out. They hyper-focus on "persuadables" and "reliable partisans." Rather than trying to compete with their resources, we maximize your impact by speaking directly to Americans who feel left behind as they lose their fundamental rights.
We drive these eligible citizens to participation by helping them understand the stakes and showing how their vote matters . That's why our voter registration efforts are so important: Everyone should vote and feel invested in the outcome.
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. Will you step up with $30 or more today to help register 10 new voters? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052826_1&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052826_1&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052826_1&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052826_1&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052826_1&amount=100] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=052826_1&amount=250] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052826_1&amount=36]
Unfortunately, we don't have anywhere near the resources to blanket the country with our efforts. Each election cycle, we target specific states where our efforts will make the greatest difference, like Nevada, North Carolina, or Michigan.
The key is getting these disenfranchised people -- always the first target of opponents of voting rights across the country -- to see the importance of voting now more than ever.
Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed over the last few years.
New voter registration -- at a cost to us of just about $3 per new voter -- is the whole ballgame. Can you pitch in with $30 or however much you can to help us register new voters ahead of registration deadlines? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=052826_1&amount=30]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=052826_1&amount=20]

name: Sharif Street
subject: Thank you — The fight for you continues
disclaimer_text: Paid for By Sharif Street for Us
body:
| | Dear Friends,

While the results of last week’s election were not what we had hoped for, my heart is filled with nothing but immense gratitude for this incredible community.

First and foremost, I want to thank each and every one of you. To our volunteers, organizers, donors, workers, and every single person who knocked on doors, made phone calls, talked with friends and neighbors, and believed in this mission: Thank you. This campaign was powered by your passion, your energy, and your unwavering dedication.

I am incredibly proud of the race we ran and the vital issues we championed together. Throughout this campaign, we lifted up the voices of working families and fought for the things that matter most: ensuring access to quality, affordable health care, driving down the murder rate, making real investments directly into our communities and development and growth focused squarely on delivering real results for Philadelphians who have been left behind.

We saw that message resonate deeply. We received support from every single corner of the city, bringing together a broad and diverse coalition of people ready for change. I will always be profoundly grateful for the trust, warmth, and support you extended to me throughout this journey. I am also so proud of the coalition that came together – labor and business, elected and community, Muslim, Jewish and Christian, LGBTQ and straight. We are better when we look out for our neighbors and stand for acceptance and success for everyone and against bigotry and hate, even where that might not be expedient.

While this particular race has come to an end, our work is far from over. I am going to take this incredible energy, this momentum, and these shared values back to Harrisburg.

I will continue to stand up and fight for you every single day in the State Senate. We will legalize marijuana, deliver gun violence prevention funds, and fight to make everyday life more affordable for everyone.

As Democrats, we have a critical mission ahead of us – we must flip the State Senate, protect House Speaker Joanna McClinton’s gavel, reelect Josh Shapiro and Austin Davis, flip swing congressional districts, protect our progress and deliver the change that our families and communities deserve. And in the years ahead, we must recapture the White House and undo the damage done by Donald Trump and those that have served him on Capitol Hill.

Thank you again for your support, your dedication and your faith in our collective future. The journey continues, and I am honored to be in this fight alongside you.

With deep gratitude,

Sharif Street

name: Dan Cox
subject: Ed Hale Said This Out Loud
body:
Ed Hale suggested higher tolls for Maryland drivers. | |
---
| | |
---
| , Ed Hale said the quiet part out loud this week. During a recent interview, **Hale suggested raising Maryland tolls** “to pay for our bridges” even after Republicans fought for years to lower those costs on working families. Then he said **he would _not_ support the Republican nominee for governor if he loses the primary**. And when discussing the Republican field, he dismissed other GOP candidates as “ridiculous.” That’s not leadership. And it’s certainly not how you unify a party that needs to defeat Wes Moore in November. **He also refused to commit to debating fellow Republicans and struggled to give clear answers on some of the biggest issues Maryland families care about, **including parental rights in schools and the future of the costly Blueprint education plan. Maryland Republicans are tired of candidates who sound conservative during campaign season, but won’t clearly fight for conservative principles when it matters. **I’ve been clear from the beginning about where I stand:**
* Lower taxes and fees
* Bring down utility costs and energy mandates
* Restore parental rights in education
* Support law enforcement
* Cut wasteful government spending

**And unlike Ed Hale, I will support the Republican nominee no matter what happens on June 23, because beating Wes Moore matters more than personal ego.** But here’s the reality: we are now in the final stretch of this race. Our campaign is reaching voters across Maryland every single day through digital outreach, mail, signs, and grassroots events. Momentum is building, but we need the resources to keep pushing forward. If you’re ready to help elect a Republican who will actually fight for Maryland families, I’m asking for your support today. [Will you chip in $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can to help us finish strong?](https://us.list-manage.com/ddVDmIWOQRv?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) Thank you for standing with us.

Cheers for Freedom,

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
This race could be the one that decides the majority.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3327%2E21716%2E6JEw2i)
On Tuesday night, James Talarico officially got an opponent in the Texas Senate race. It’s Ken Paxton, one of the most corrupt politicians in the country. He was impeached by a bipartisan majority in the Texas House and has been called "unelectable" by members of his own party.
**There are a million reasons why Ken Paxton doesn’t belong in the Senate. But what I want to focus on is why James Talarico _does_ belong there.**
He’s a Texas state representative, a former middle school teacher, and an eighth-generation Texan who has spent his time in office taking on the billionaire mega-donors and puppet politicians who’ve bought out Texas politics.
And while his opponent is a Trump loyalist who will do whatever he can to advance the MAGA agenda, **James makes it clear that the biggest divide in our country isn’t left vs. right. It’s top vs. bottom.** It’s between the people with all the wealth and power — and everyone else working hard to build a good life for their families.
James is running for the U.S. Senate with a message that feels rare in politics right now — one rooted not in fear, hate, or division, but in love for our neighbors and country. He has a rare opportunity to flip Texas blue for the first time in decades, but he’s going to need our support to do it.
[**That’s why I’m asking you to split a donation between my campaign and James Talarico’s today.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260528-1.Cv-P_S&refcode=em20260528-3327&t=2&akid=3327%2E21716%2E6JEw2i)

When I decided to run for reelection to the U.S. Senate, it was not a decision I made lightly. Asking Virginians to rehire me is a humbling task – and it’s one that I take very seriously.

**But Derek, after seeing the crazed, dangerous, and callous actions of the second Trump term, I’m all-in on this race.**

In my time in public service, I’ve never seen anything like I have the last sixteen months. Trump’s policies are skyrocketing prices for working families. They’re stripping health care away from millions of Americans to pay for tax breaks for those at the very top. And their reckless foreign policy is making our country less safe. And all the while, I’ve been disappointed to see too many of my Republican colleagues refuse to take any meaningful action to hold Trump and his reckless administration accountable.

**But frankly, I also know that this race has to be about more than simply what we’re _against_ – we need a vision of what we’re fighting _for_.**

I’m running for reelection to not only continue standing up to the Trump administration’s chaos and corruption, but to also deliver real results for Virginia’s families:

→ We need universal health care in this country. I’ve long supported Obamacare, but simply patching up the old system isn’t cutting it anymore for the families who can’t pay their hospital bills or for life-saving prescriptions.

→ Virginians are facing a housing affordability crisis. We need to build more housing, rehabilitate existing structures, speed up permitting, and make it easier for first-time home buyers to obtain a mortgage.

→ We need to prepare our workforce for the economies of the future – making sure working Americans benefit from the good that could come from Artificial Intelligence and make sure Big Tech pays their fair share for the demand they’re placing on our energy grid.

→ We’ve got to stand up for America’s critical role in the world. That means working with our allies – not against them – and restoring our leadership on the world stage.

**Folks, there’s no doubt these are big challenges – but I’ve never been afraid of a tough fight, and I know you aren’t either.**

So here’s the deal: my campaign is coming up on our end-of-month fundraising deadline and we’ve set an ambitious goal of raising $50,000 from grassroots donors like you before the month ends.

These fundraising benchmarks are critical for my fight to protect this Senate seat and elect Democrats in all corners of the Commonwealth to flip the balance of power in Washington. clean_body: Hundreds of Pennsylvanians are heading to Harrisburg to demand lawmakers tax billionaires and Big Tech. | | | Peter, For the last six months, the Tax Billionaires, Fund PA campaign has been demanding that our elected officials take action to address the rising cost of living. Everything keeps getting more expensive. Paychecks are barely budging. Healthcare and food costs are rising. And while Pennsylvania families are being asked to do more with less, billionaires and the biggest corporations keep getting richer, while benefiting from tax breaks and loopholes that let them avoid paying what they owe. We’re fighting to change that. This Monday, June 1st hundreds of Pennsylvanians are heading to Harrisburg to demand that lawmakers tax billionaires and Big Tech, not cut the services our communities rely on. Your donation will help cover transportation, food, and organizing costs so working people from across Pennsylvania can get to Harrisburg and make their voices heard. As lawmakers debate the state budget, we’re making sure they hear from the people most impacted by these decisions. Our coalition has a plan to raise almost $6 billion in new revenue by closing corporate tax loopholes, making Big Tech pay for the digital ads cluttering our screens, and taxing Pennsylvania billionaires’ unearned income. That money could help stop cuts to vital services and make life more affordable for families across the Commonwealth. And momentum is building: more than 40 state legislators have signed on, and our bill to tax Big Tech advanced last week with a hearing in the House. Now, as legislators begin debating the state budget, we need to make sure they hear from working people, not just lobbyists, corporate interests, and billionaires. That’s why on Monday, June 1st, hundreds of people from across Pennsylvania are heading to the State Capitol in Harrisburg with a clear demand: Tax Billionaires. Fund PA. It’s an important moment for this campaign. A strong showing at the Capitol will help demonstrate just how much support there is across Pennsylvania for taxing billionaires and Big Tech instead of cutting the services our communities rely on. To help make that happen, we’re covering transportation, food, organizing materials, and the costs of mobilizing people from across the state so that working people are in the room when lawmakers are making decisions about our future. This is how change happens in Pennsylvania: when everyday people organize, show up, and demand a government that works for all of us, not just the ultra-wealthy. In solidarity, PA Working Families Power Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. Want to learn more about Working Families Power? In recent years, many Americans have been told that faith belongs behind stained-glass windows and nowhere else. We are told that Christianity must be private, silent, and unseen in the civic arena. But that idea is not only historically inaccurate; it is fundamentally un-American. The truth is simple: faith was never meant to be confined to the shadows. It shaped our founding, guided our laws, and undergirded our understanding of liberty. Christianity cannot be silenced in the public square because it is woven into the moral fabric that made the public square possible in the first place.

body:
I’m not asking you to choose between New Hampshire and the rest of the map. I’m telling you New Hampshire is the map.
Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve worked Senate races in every corner of the country, and I know how to read a map. So hear me when I say this: **New Hampshire is keeping me up at night.**
I’m watching this year’s races closely, and money is pouring into Georgia, North Carolina, Ohio, Texas, Alaska, and Maine. That’s critical because those races are part of Democrats’ path to retaking the Senate.
But here’s what’s scaring the hell out of me: **If Chris Pappas loses New Hampshire, Democrats need to flip FIVE seats instead of four to take back the Senate. That math doesn’t work. Full stop.**
**[Before you read another word, chip in $10 or whatever you can to Chris Pappas and Heartland Patriots to make sure New Hampshire doesn’t become the reason Democrats lose the Senate.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/104422?refcode=em20260528-10499&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10499%2E614464%2ElA0P0b)**

John Sununu — yeah, _those Sununus_ — has the name, the money, and a Republican machine that knows exactly what’s at stake here. They don’t need to flip five seats. They just need to flip New Hampshire red and let the map do the rest.
And right now? **They’ve got a real shot at doing exactly that.**

body:
Fraud and mismanagement aren’t isolated incidents in Gavin Newsom’s California, they have become systemic failures with real, painful consequences | | |
---
| |
# No more punishing taxpayers for Sacramento’s failures
---
| Dear Friend, Fraud and mismanagement aren’t isolated incidents in Gavin Newsom’s California, they have become systemic failures with real, painful consequences for our local families, small businesses, and farmers. During the pandemic, Sacramento took a disastrous "pay now, verify later" approach to unemployment. They threw out common sense safeguards and invited massive fraud on the taxpayer’s dime. The result? At least $32 billion in fraudulent payments went out the door, including up to $1 billion sent directly to state prison inmates, murderers, and death row occupants. Worse yet, despite sitting on a massive $98 billion budget surplus in the past, Governor Newsom refused to pay back the federal government. Today, California is the only state in the nation that still has an outstanding federal unemployment debt, a staggering $18 billion tab. Because Sacramento failed to pay its bills, our local job creators are being punished with automatic, massive federal payroll tax hikes. Enough is enough. That is why I have officially introduced the Creating Accountability in Loan (CAL) Repayment Act. [Here is a television story on the bill.](https://us.list-manage.com/rrxGDUCOnh9?e=affd398937&c2id=4fd8e839bd16eef39626cb246bcc01d8) Our bill is rooted in a simple principle: states must be held accountable for their financial negligence, and taxpayers should never be forced to bail out government incompetence. Specifically, the CAL Repayment Act will:
* **Force State Accountability:** Require states with outstanding federal unemployment debt to use any flexible federal funding they receive to pay off that debt first before spending money on anything else.
* **Protect Small Businesses:** Halt the unfair, compounding payroll tax increases on employers by forcing states to clear their balances.
* **Establish Strict Enforcement:** Mandate that any state violating these rules must immediately repay the misused federal funds back to the treasury within five business days.

We cannot allow Sacramento's negligence to crush the businesses that keep the Central Valley’s economy moving. I recently took to the pages of the New York Post to publish an op-ed exposing this absolute disaster, calling out how California's fraud has become a systemic failure under Gavin Newsom. Now, I am taking that exact fight directly to the House floor. But the special interests who benefit from this broken system are fighting back, and they want to silence our push for fiscal sanity. I need your help to keep the pressure on. Will you stand with me today by making a contribution of $20, $50, or $100 to support our efforts to bring accountability back to our government?

name: Wes Moore
subject: This email is about saying goodbye
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1433%2E1086043%2E_LUc38)
This is a longer email about saying goodbye, Peter, but if you don’t have time to read through, I would deeply appreciate **[a contribution to power our campaign before our end-of-month deadline this weekend.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260528-1.5N_Dah&refcode=em-20260528-1&t=2&akid=1433%2E1086043%2E_LUc38)**
After nearly a century of operation, Valley Forge Military Academy — the place where I went to school and grew from an angry, complicated child to a confident young man — has closed.
When my mother first sent me to the Forge, she saw military school as a last resort in response to a seemingly endless chain of misbehavior, both at home and at school. At age 11, I’d already felt handcuffs on my wrists. **I was not on a path to success.**
There was no overnight miracle when I started school there, but slowly, things changed. I learned about honor, code, and service. I started to take an interest in campus life, academics, and leadership positions — and I rose up the ranks and became a first captain in command of around 800 cadets.
After graduation, I went on to study at Johns Hopkins and Oxford, deployed to Afghanistan with the 82nd Airborne Division, ran one of the largest poverty-fighting organizations in the country, and now, I serve as the 63rd governor of Maryland _and the first Black governor in the history of my state._
What saddens me most isn’t losing a place I once called home. My memories will forever live on with me.
**It saddens me that other young men like me will have one fewer avenue to challenge themselves and build their own pathway to success.**
Peter, at a time where our young men and boys are falling behind and feeling isolated, we have to offer more paths for connection and engagement.
I know Valley Forge Military Academy did that for me, and I’m determined to find ways to do that for young Marylanders today.
That includes the **Maryland Corps and Service Year Option** — the first statewide program in the country to give high school graduates a year of paid, full-time community service on the path to college or a career.
We have to help young Marylanders find the thing that guides them on a pathway to success and that inspires them to serve. **[If you support that mission, I would appreciate a donation to keep me in the fight as Maryland's governor today.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260528-1.5N_Dah&refcode=em-20260528-1&t=3&akid=1433%2E1086043%2E_LUc38)**
Elevate,
Wes
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260528-1.5N_Dah&refcode=em-20260528-1&t=4&akid=1433%2E1086043%2E_LUc38)

# 🚨BREAKING: Oil Prices Pull Back on US-Iran Ceasefire Deal
Oil prices **[pulled back from earlier highs](https://substack.com/redirect/86ddec9e-bb2c-411e-915d-803594310ae6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after reports that U.S. and Iranian negotiators reached a 60-day memorandum of understanding to extend the ceasefire and begin nuclear program negotiations, pending President Trump's approval.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/86ddec9e-bb2c-411e-915d-803594310ae6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Ceasefire Extension Reached** : Negotiators agreed to 60-day Memorandum of Understanding to extend ceasefire and start Iran's nuclear program talks, **[sources told Axios.](https://substack.com/redirect/86730a20-2f54-4790-a137-71245a6ed0f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
**Military Strikes Exchanged** : U.S. and Iran traded attacks with Iran targeting a U.S. air base and launching ballistic missiles toward Kuwait that were intercepted.
**Strait of Hormuz Tensions** : Fears revived over control of **[key oil shipping route](https://substack.com/redirect/dbaeb215-cf51-4770-9ff5-4bc4dfaa5731?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with Iran believed to effectively control it regardless of any deal.

# New York state passes Mamdani's tax on second homes
New York state **[lawmakers approved a pied-a-terre tax on nonprimary residences](https://substack.com/redirect/c7ff5f1e-fdc6-401b-8f30-55401bfe10c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/c7ff5f1e-fdc6-401b-8f30-55401bfe10c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)valued at $1 million or more to help close the city's budget gap, targeting luxury properties in phased implementation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c7ff5f1e-fdc6-401b-8f30-55401bfe10c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Tax Rates Phased In** : Initial years apply 4 to 6.5 percent rates on properties over $1 million with gradual valuation updates using comparable sales later.
**Significant Impact on Wealthy** : The tax could more than triple property tax bills for owners like Citadel CEO Ken Griffin on his high-value Manhattan apartments.
**Revenue Projection** : Officials expect the measure to generate $500 million annually for the city budget.
**Valuation System Noted** : Current city assessments often undervalue properties dramatically compared to market prices, affecting effective tax burden.

# Trump's economy gets a thumbs up from Big Bank's CEO's
CEOs of JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America and Wells Fargo **[described a still extremely strong U.S. economy](https://substack.com/redirect/e362a202-933b-4a98-b4f6-c2d1144bc0f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** driven by robust consumer spending and healthy businesses, while noting some cautionary signals.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e362a202-933b-4a98-b4f6-c2d1144bc0f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Consumer Spend Strong** : Wells Fargo's Charles Scharf said consumer spending is even stronger recently despite record low sentiment, though higher oil prices could impact it.
**Businesses Financially Solid** : Bank clients are not growing inventories aggressively due to uncertainty but remain very strong financially and borrowing modestly.
**Wall Street Growth Expected** : Banks anticipate sizable revenue increases from trading and dealmaking, including potential record IPO activity with SpaceX and others.
**Growth Forecast Adjusted** : Bank of America lowered 2026 U.S. growth outlook to 2.2 percent but called it reasonably strong historically.

# Caesars casino to be acquired in $17.6B All-Cash deal at $31 a share
Casino operator Caesars Entertainment **[agreed to be acquired by Fertitta Entertainment](https://substack.com/redirect/5b4f907c-0ab0-483f-9ea8-607b41c3cfff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in a $17.6 billion all-cash deal that includes assumption of $11.9 billion in debt, offering shareholders $31 per share.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5b4f907c-0ab0-483f-9ea8-607b41c3cfff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Premium for Shareholders** : The offer represents a 7.7 percent premium to Wednesday's closing price with a go-shop period through July 11 for potential better bids.
**Leadership Continuity** : Caesars CEO Tom Reeg, CFO and COO will stay in roles while the Carano family that owns 5% will roll their equity into the new entity.
**Combined Portfolio** : Deal brings together 60 casino resorts, online gaming, over 600 restaurants and additional entertainment assets.
**Long Pursued Merger** : Tilman Fertitta has sought combination of Caesars properties with his Landry's and Golden Nugget holdings.

# Software company Snowflake surges 35% on AI momentum and Amazon Deal
Software stock Snowflake is headed for its **[best day ever as shares surged 35 percent](https://substack.com/redirect/a0a49362-c891-4a33-834a-d02a0f918bc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/a0a49362-c891-4a33-834a-d02a0f918bc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)after topping earnings estimates, boosting guidance and announcing a major AI compute partnership with Amazon.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/22fa8631-8a3d-4631-a16d-77591a095514?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**AI Tools Transform Operations** : Finance chief Brian Robins said tools such as Cortex Code are driving a step function change in AI revenue potential and boosting productivity.
**Guidance Raised Significantly** : Snowflake expects stronger fiscal second-quarter operating margin and product revenue amid growing momentum in its AI-powered offerings like Snowflake Intelligence.
**Software Stocks Lifted** : Results eased SaaSpocalypse fears and sent ServiceNow up 5 percent while Oracle and Palantir gained over 3 percent each.
**Customer Base Expands** : Company added 616 net new customers for 38 percent growth and now counts 779 spending more than $1 million annually.
* * *
* * *
# Nebius AI stock surges on Ex-OpenAI fund stake disclosure
Nebius shares jumped after a hedge fund founded by former OpenAI researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner **[disclosed owning a 5.6 percent stake](https://substack.com/redirect/bfcee8ec-62d6-4a15-bce9-0e5d76e796d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in the European AI cloud and GPU provider.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bfcee8ec-62d6-4a15-bce9-0e5d76e796d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Major Stake Disclosed** : Situational Awareness fund now holds over 12 million Class A shares of Nebius, which provides GPUs for training AI models.
**European AI Compute Leader** : The company has secured a $27 billion deal with Meta and a $2 billion investment from Nvidia for AI infrastructure.
**Stock Performance Strong** : Nebius popped in premarket trading and is up 149 percent year-to-date following the filing.
**Infrastructure Focus** : The hedge fund invests in physical infrastructure needed for future AI development.
* * *
* * *
# 19% of auto loans monthly payments exceed $1000
Nearly 19 percent of new vehicle loans **[now require monthly payments of $1,000 or more,](https://substack.com/redirect/12f183e1-a6b7-4a72-8eea-0d25e637a5c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** up from last year, with most for non-luxury models especially popular pickup trucks.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/40f32be3-457b-4a3a-bc8c-d06dd9c787e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Non-Luxury Dominates** : Almost 74 percent of high-payment loans are for mainstream vehicles with Ford F-150, Chevrolet Silverado and Ram 1500 leading.
**Average Loan Record High** : Borrowed amounts reached an all-time high of nearly $44,000 with average monthly payment climbing to $770.
**Market Shift Noted** : Higher vehicle prices from recent years have normalized larger payments for consumers.
**Delinquencies Low** : Auto loan delinquency rates remain below 2018 levels though subprime borrowers show higher risk.

body:
I’m feeling a little sentimental and wanted to share some pictures with you!!!

| | | | I’m coming to you as a Navy Veteran, Nurse Practitioner, GOP Congresswoman, but most importantly as a MOM.
I was looking through some old photos recently and wanted to share a few with you. They help tell my story, but also explain why I’m the Democrats #1 target in the upcoming midterm elections!![](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNTI4X0hQLVo0LjExMDExN190MTkxMDgyOC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDUyOF9IUC1aNC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MTA4MjgtMjA2OCJ9/XwkNepL1vnuBgwDjjMTtNg)That photo above is me and my husband, Steve. He is a retired F-18 pilot, and I’m a proud Navy wife and mother to four amazing children. As the granddaughter of a veteran, daughter of a veteran, spouse of a veteran, and mother of future veterans, I come from a PROUD military family.[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNTI4X0hQLVo0LjExMDExN190MTkxMDgyOC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDUyOF9IUC1aNC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MTA4MjgtMjA2OCJ9/HQaidx-vdIYM1OoEKXW4Ag)I also served in the Navy. That photo above is my helicopter with my call sign on it - “Blossom.” I was winged as a naval aviator in 1995 and served our nation for a total of 10 years as a helicopter pilot flying H-46 and H-3 helicopters, completing two deployments to the Persian Gulf.[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNTI4X0hQLVo0LjExMDExN190MTkxMDgyOC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDUyOF9IUC1aNC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MTA4MjgtMjA2OCJ9/4L7M6yLW5Q3ittyfO487bQ)After serving in the Navy, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. It was an honor to care for our Greatest Generation, and I helped them fight the system to get the healthcare they deserve.
Over time, I got frustrated watching the evening news and just hearing about all the dysfunction and radical agendas in our government. But I’m not one to just complain about problems. I like to solve them.
So I got off my couch, and I ran for office.[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNTI4X0hQLVo0LjExMDExN190MTkxMDgyOC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDUyOF9IUC1aNC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MTA4MjgtMjA2OCJ9/4eK0Lb42b9P6uiKIbqXSdg)I served three sessions in the Virginia State Senate, where I used my real-world experience to actually solve problems. I was proud to champion legislation to promote election security, establish a Military Spouse Liaison, and advocate for patients, families, and caregivers in long-term care facilities.
Eventually, I realized a lot of the problems facing my family, our neighbors, and our community were actually coming from Washington. We were represented by a Democrat who voted with Nancy Pelosi 99% of the time, and I felt we needed a representative who would actually put our values and community first.
So, I once again decided to stop complaining and actually do something about it. So I ran for Congress! [](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNTI4X0hQLVo0LjExMDExN190MTkxMDgyOC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDUyOF9IUC1aNC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MTA4MjgtMjA2OCJ9/SwbMppoZtSuTDBoPC7042g)When I commit to something, I give it my all, and that’s what we did with the campaign. We were up against a lot. National Democrats poured over $10 million into my opponent’s campaign, and big money PACs spent even more attacking me. But, we stayed focused on the task at hand and never lost sight of why I was running. On Election Night, we won by about 10,000 votes in one of the closest races in the entire nation. [](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNTI4X0hQLVo0LjExMDExN190MTkxMDgyOC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDUyOF9IUC1aNC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MTA4MjgtMjA2OCJ9/fVWr37Wre_cKbbxRaNxPfQ)And in Congress, we’ve been able to make a big impact. I’m leading the charge to lower prices, cut taxes, get better care for our veterans, support military families, and secure the border. We’re making good progress, but all our progress could be in jeopardy if we lose in the upcoming elections.
See, that same Democrat I defeated in 2022 is back for revenge. She just announced her campaign against me, and she raised over $500,000 from Democrat activists in just a few days. The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee has announced my seat is one of their top targets, and they are already spending big on attack ads.[DONATE NOW
](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNTI4X0hQLVo0LjExMDExN190MTkxMDgyOC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDUyOF9IUC1aNC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MTA4MjgtMjA2OCJ9/XfvLt7xYlUG3F7RwKp_caA)If you want to see more regular, everyday citizens in office instead of career politicians, then I need your urgent help. Can you spare anything to help me defeat the Democrats in this #1 Battleground race?
I can’t stand sending messages like this. Sometimes I wonder what would have happened if I never got off the couch and ran for office...but then I remember that America is always worth protecting...no matter what!
Thanks for reading my message. I hope I was able to earn your support.[DONATE NOW
](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNTI4X0hQLVo0LjExMDExN190MTkxMDgyOC0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDUyOF9IUC1aNC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5MTA4MjgtMjA2OCJ9/6PKXkX9ZZ45PhSm2N1eSiw)-Jen[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)I would not be where I am today without the help of my incredible and faithful supporters like you. Because of your support, I can keep fighting to make our country stronger.

Together we will get our country back on the right track and secure America’s success! [SUPPORT JEN KIGGANS
](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)| | Paid for by Kiggans for Congress

Hello Friends,
We are just days away from the June 2nd election, and I want to encourage everyone to make a plan to vote. If you need information on where to vote, how to return your ballot, or where to find a drop box, please visit the California Secretary of State website: Here [https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections]
I’ve spent my career fighting for California families — first as a social worker, then as a State Assemblymember, and now as a two-term California State Superintendent of Public Instruction. At every level, my work has centered on helping people!
I’m running for Governor because too many Californians are being pushed out by rising costs and a lack of leadership focused on everyday people. Families are struggling to afford housing, groceries, gas, childcare, and healthcare while homelessness continues to grow across our communities. Californians deserve a Governor that takes these challenges seriously and delivers real solutions.
My plan starts with building 2 million affordable housing units by 2030 so working families, young people, and seniors can afford to stay in California. I also want to expand down payment assistance for first-time homebuyers, support small businesses, create good paying jobs, increase access to childcare and education, and hold large corporations accountable for driving up costs.

the most critical Senate races in the country.

Chris

body:
The Riverside GOP just admitted exactly why they’re scared.

| |
---
| | Peter, the Republican Party of Riverside County just posted this warning about me: “Esther Kim is the Democrats’ #1 recruit to flip CA-40, hand Hakeem Jeffries the gavel, and shut down the Trump agenda!” They’re absolutely right 😂 That is EXACTLY why I’m running.
* To flip CA-40.
* To take back the House.

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Newsweek: Is Donald Trump's New Census Constitutional? [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/Newsweek_TrumpCensus.png]
Team: President Donald Trump is looking to change the way the U.S. Census Bureau collects data, posting on Truth Social that his new method would utilize " the results and information gained from the Presidential Election of 2024 ."
Though any efforts to change how the census is conducted are sure to face legal challenges, Trump's directive threatens to shift the balance of political power in the country.
We would like to hear from more voters in your area on this issue. Will you take our one-question poll right away?
Team: Do you support a new, mid-decade census based on the 2024 election?
By clicking a response below your answer will be automatically recorded:
YES [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-pollresponse?refcode=052826_2yes&amount=15] NO [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-pollresponse?refcode=052826_2no&amount=15]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

These are organizations that _pushed for indictments_ of President Trump's supporters, lawyers, activists, and officials who challenged the results of the 2020 election. Judicial Watch has reason to believe**there is collaboration between these groups and others states too** , and _[you can be a part of exposing it with a gift today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83119&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)_. | [Keep Exposing this Leftist Lawfare Machine ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83119&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)
**Why The Lawsuit Matters To You** After state officials failed to respond to our Nevada Public Records Act request, Judicial Watch sued the state of Nevada Attorney General's office for _documents_ involving and _communications_ with _two progressive NGO 's_: **States United Democracy Center** and the **Voter Protection Project**. The **States United Democracy Center** reportedly has provided "legal blueprints" which have been used to prosecute alternate slates of Republican electors from the 2020 election. The **Voter Protection Project** is a left-wing political action committee that _donates to far-left candidates_ who support _eliminating_ many U.S. election security laws. | [Fuel More Public Records Lawsuits ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83119&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)
**The newly released records include:**
* A January 2021 internal email from **States United Democracy Center** referencing a one-hour "AG Briefing" featuring outside participants.

* An April 15, 2021 email where the President of **Voter Protection Program** writes to **Nevada Attorney General** Aaron D. Ford _requesting he sign onto an open letter_ from current and former state officials **expressing**** _" concern about voting restrictions being proposed across the country"_**.

_Nevada signed the letter as requested on April 27_.
* A February 2025 email to the Nevada Chief Deputy Attorney General Greg D. Ott **requesting Deputy Attorney General Devin Oliver be added to the States United Democracy Center 's****monthly conference calls** as "He's _coordinating_ much of the _multistate litigation_ here and I think it would be beneficial for him to hear the litigation summaries that your team provides."

**Evidence of a Multi-State Lawfare Campaign** **__This doesn 't just involve Nevada__**** _._**
* In November, another **Judicial Watch** public records _lawsuit_ exposed _5,789 pages_ of records from the **Michigan** Department of Attorney General which show _close coordination_ with **States United Democracy Center.**

* **Judicial Watch** has also filed a **Georgia** Public Records lawsuit against **Fani Willis** in her capacity as district attorney for communications and agreements with the States United Democracy Center and/or the Voter Protection Project.

* And, we are also actively working to obtain records from **Arizona** and **Wisconsin** which appear to have been part of the same _coordinated effort_ by States United Democracy Center.

_This is a nationwide problem, and it affects you and me_. **That 's why Judicial Watch is fighting to pull back the curtain on these coordinated efforts between states and leftist activist organizations.** | [Your Donation Will Help Us Fight Back ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83119&L=37724&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL25kZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=68b0847428117e51ab31039e4536c339c16f4773136bac0bfa7930b30eeb998b)
**No one has done more** to _expose lawfare_ against President Trump and his supporters than Judicial Watch over the last decade. But these fights are complex, and expensive. **_It is_**** _only through the generous support of Americans like you_** that Judicial Watch can file and litigate these needed public records requests and lawsuits in _multiple states simultaneously_. I never take that lightly, and it means so much to have supporters like you by my side for these big fights. [**We're facing a major deadline against an opponent taking money from special interests, and I hope you'll continue to stand with me. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | Hello, Most Americans don’t realize they’re losing money to taxes until it’s too late. name: Ximena, United We Dream
subject: Peter, we can't do this without you
body:
May was a big month at UWD. Chip in to keep the momentum! | | |
Peter, This month, you showed up — and it showed. May was a powerful reminder of what is possible when we come together. Here's what our community accomplished: **Bruce Springsteen put a spotlight on our work.** Legendary musician Bruce Springsteen invited United We Dream to be the organization he chose to uplift during his "Land of Hope & Dreams" tour stop in Elmont, NY. Our team was on the ground connecting with concertgoers who were energized, fired up, and ready to take action with us. Many donated to our work — and we couldn't be more grateful. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAeIdicNPDEjB8U81Sf47SIVH6uNxujjX6zH2gVOwoU3uXa75OsD3JMEzyWdrmwQq8L-6vjwe6vCqfNcj2CsjnINMCUk01vtzUL5C94jXsCWs0rf6yR0UoFVtcss87gpb9j8qgPWQ2RBFlsSZOKV66_PEJAz3nYCNNp0rzeTN6Wo8AMwhfkawT8AREwywLvIjcIckngANvSRORa6Wz1qPDIyXu6HHcm9WMH4pV8Ga8jgGW4LZ6CnQbzEx77WXPtNv3Qxwr1fp9LE9ZanS3rTQ43hOttDJS3V9hCjAlP9ZrPrEDVY9cniPj5EKlZU6ihz1blo0hPp3SqgaZ70vdOOJIRXa149k6D33uqciPDijGVgkebRm_ovzHeu4j4PnDh2oTdAXDiJ-8oZLMRC79yGkQilQ/4r0/ytnZ-RvzQHy_smSe9mxjpg/h0/h001.18fxdYomRvH2DsImt8GmfCWNyBu7G_0KIjEHw7RJscE) **We organized for DACA recipients facing renewal delays.** With more and more of our neighbors reporting months-long delays in getting their status renewed, we hosted our "Navigating DACA Renewal Delays Together" Community Call and launched "Letters for Our Neighbors" — gathering communities across the country to write letters to Congress calling for a pathway to citizenship. clean_body: May was a big month at UWD. Chip in to keep the momentum! | | | Peter, This month, you showed up — and it showed. May was a powerful reminder of what is possible when we come together. Here's what our community accomplished: Bruce Springsteen put a spotlight on our work. Legendary musician Bruce Springsteen invited United We Dream to be the organization he chose to uplift during his "Land of Hope & Dreams" tour stop in Elmont, NY. Our team was on the ground connecting with concertgoers who were energized, fired up, and ready to take action with us. Many donated to our work — and we couldn't be more grateful. We organized for DACA recipients facing renewal delays. With more and more of our neighbors reporting months-long delays in getting their status renewed, we hosted our "Navigating DACA Renewal Delays Together" Community Call and launched "Letters for Our Neighbors" — gathering communities across the country to write letters to Congress calling for a pathway to citizenship. Your neighbors have already sent more than 50,000 letters. Greisa was named to the TIME100 Philanthropy list. Our Executive Director, Greisa Martínez Rosas, was recognized as one of the most influential leaders across the country, shaping the future of giving. This honor belongs to our 1.2 million members and to the leader we have entrusted United We Dream with. This resilience runs in our veins. Generation after generation, our communities have faced moments of intense fear and uncertainty — and every time, we have moved forward together. It wasn't because I wasn't performing up to task or because of budget cuts. It was because I spoke up about the war in Gaza when staying quiet would have been the safer, easier thing for my career.
I knew what it might cost me, but I also knew what was right.

That's more than Chuck frickin' Schumer...

Texans are ready for a change.
On Tuesday, Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton (one of the most corrupt politicians in the country) became the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate. And in November, he’ll face Democrat James Talarico—a leader who believes in public service, integrity, and bringing people together instead of tearing them apart.
Ken Paxton has spent years putting himself ahead of Texans. He’s been indicted, impeached by members of his own party, and embroiled in scandal after scandal—all while serving as one of Donald Trump’s most loyal political allies.
Texans deserve better.
And James is hitting the road to tell Texans how he will deliver it as our next U.S. Senator. I was glad to welcome him to Houston for the first stop on his The People vs. Ken Paxton Tour. The line to get in to see him was around the corner, and the energy was everywhere!

Winning in Texas is possible, but it won’t be easy. Republican operatives are already doing what they do: trying to scare voters by telling lies and pitting Texans against one another.
But we know better. And we know we deserve more than what the Republicans in charge of our state have delivered—or failed to deliver—for the last 30 years they have been in charge here.
That’s why #TeamLizzie is gearing up to get out the vote across Harris and Fort Bend Counties, and to help candidates across Texas. We know that the Texas Senate race and so much more depends on a strong showing here at home. We are laying out our strategy, scheduling our Days of Action, preparing for our summer intern class, and partnering with Democrats up and down the ballot to do all the things it will take to deliver a win this big.
Because a win this big isn’t just a win for Texans, it’s a win for America. And your support makes it possible.

Happy AANHPI Heritage Month.

This month always gives me a moment to reflect on how far families like mine have come.

My parents fled Vietnam searching for freedom and opportunity. They worked long hours to build a life for our family here in Orange County, and like so many immigrant parents, they sacrificed everything so their children could have a better future.

**I carry that story with me every day in Congress – and I’m deeply proud to represent one of the largest AANHPI communities in the country right here in CA-45.**

But I also know there’s still so much work ahead.

Too many working families are struggling with rising costs. Programs that families rely on are under attack. And extremists in Washington continue trying to divide communities instead of delivering real solutions.

That’s part of why this race matters so much. And it's what I focus on as national Republicans target this seat to expand their majority.

| | **A NOTE FROM CHRISSY**
---
| | **what $85 BILLION could do**
---
When Republicans passed their budget last year, they gave a total of $85 BILLION to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). Budgets are a reflection of our values, and there's a lot more we could do of value with that money. Just take a look. This same money could fund:
---
* SNAP benefits in Pennsylvania for 20 years
* Medicaid in Pennsylvania for 3 years
* The National School Lunch Program for 4.5 years
* Veterans Affairs mental health services for 5 years
* Head Start for 5 years
* The entire U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) for 1.5 years

---
ICE agents have shaken families and raised fear and confusion. We need immigration reform and secure borders, but ICE is _not_ reform. Adding more of your taxpayer dollars to a broken system helps no one, except perhaps the private detention corporations across our Commonwealth and country.
---
| | **AFFORDABILITY IN ACTION**
---
No matter your politics, affordability is one of the biggest issues affecting our community – and country – right now. I know it's top of mind for many of my constituents, which is why I'm traveling across the district this spring to put affordability into action and hear directly from you about costs – and how we can bring them down. Each of us has a household budget, and right now, it’s too difficult to get ahead and many of us are struggling just to get by. I’m working with my colleagues in the _**[New Democrat Coalition](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132252371/623904659/-2091648417?refcode=jtk1259-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNWNjZDU3YS1jNzVhLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8B2vdlm3LP7q71D5T50Q1Q0y7z4gVDfcH_jzUUv0Hxc=&emci=3498dd48-cf59-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=d5ccd57a-c75a-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=21278485)**_ on commonsense ways to lower costs on everything from groceries to housing to utilities – and a lot more!
---
| | **I QUESTIONED HEGSETH**
---
In April, I questioned Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in a House Armed Services Committee hearing. He evaded every question, from how long this war will last to how much money is coming out of the pocket of the American taxpayer to fund this endless war. Our soldiers, sailors, airmen, and marines are in harm's way because he and President Trump made a choice to go to war without a plan. Their arrogance and ignorance are costly and deadly. We deserve answers and simply put, we all deserve better.

As a third-generation veteran, I took an oath to uphold and defend this country – which is why I'm fighting day after day against Hegseth's reckless and dangerous agenda, and I'm continuing to call for his resignation.
---
Thank you for your support, Derek.

There's work to be done,

Chrissy

That is the President of the United States, on the record, saying: pass the SAVE America Act NOW. Use the Housing Bill. Use the FISA Bill. Get it done.

And he is right.

**Maryland just had 500,000 fake mail-in ballots exposed.** Not five hundred. Not five thousand. FIVE HUNDRED THOUSAND. That is a whole city's worth of crooked ballots in one blue state.

The President is demanding action. The American people are demanding action. And what are Senate Democrats doing?

They are hiding behind the zombie filibuster.

That is what I call it. The filibuster used to mean something. A senator had to stand on the Senate floor, hold the microphone, and make his case out loud. Today? Schumer's team can just send a one-line email and kill any bill they don't like — without ever showing their face on camera.

It is cowardly. It is dishonest. And it is killing this country.

That is why the President is right to demand we put the SAVE America Act inside the Housing and FISA bills. Those bills have to pass. If Democrats want to shut down housing and surveillance authority over election integrity, let them try to explain that to the American people in broad daylight.

**[Help me end this fight. clean_body: The President spoke. Now Senate Democrats are hiding behind the zombie filibuster. | Peter, President Trump just sent a clear message to every Republican in Washington. He posted it on Truth Social. I want you to read it in his own words: That is the President of the United States, on the record, saying: pass the SAVE America Act NOW. Use the Housing Bill. Use the FISA Bill. Get it done. And he is right. Maryland just had 500,000 fake mail-in ballots exposed. Not five hundred. Not five thousand. FIVE HUNDRED THOUSAND. That is a whole city's worth of crooked ballots in one blue state. The President is demanding action. The American people are demanding action. And what are Senate Democrats doing? They are hiding behind the zombie filibuster. That is what I call it. The filibuster used to mean something. A senator had to stand on the Senate floor, hold the microphone, and make his case out loud. Today? Schumer's team can just send a one-line email and kill any bill they don't like — without ever showing their face on camera. It is cowardly. It is dishonest. And it is killing this country. That is why the President is right to demand we put the SAVE America Act inside the Housing and FISA bills. Those bills have to pass. If Democrats want to shut down housing and surveillance authority over election integrity, let them try to explain that to the American people in broad daylight. President Trump has done his part. He laid down the marker. Now it is on the Senate to deliver. I am ready to go. But we need to drown out Schumer's noise machine. The only way we beat the zombie filibuster is if folks like you stand up loud enough to make it impossible to ignore. Voter ID. Proof of citizenship. Honest elections. These are not radical ideas. body:
https://secure.everyaction.com/x_oKQZJtdUqJTyiBsVJg6A2?am=20&contactdata=d/vHrdjKripIyJvqlK1Nls0dRqWFYvxUf/cVgpnAHt+nSzlsJ3/iaeHBpsFBtsdIPSpGuh5hG157cfiboCoWOsmcvqjqpm+mmkn/KVVsyTIf81oT83/+Capxf5i0bFC5 [https://secure.everyaction.com/x_oKQZJtdUqJTyiBsVJg6A2?am=20&contactdata=d/vHrdjKripIyJvqlK1Nls0dRqWFYvxUf/cVgpnAHt+nSzlsJ3/iaeHBpsFBtsdIPSpGuh5hG157cfiboCoWOsmcvqjqpm+mmkn/KVVsyTIf81oT83/+Capxf5i0bFC5]
Peter,
This primary election, Oregon voters showed up for climate leadership, and together, we made it happen.
Thanks to supporters like you, OLCV and OLCV PAC helped elect and advance climate champions across Oregon, including some major victories in key legislative and local races.
In one of our top priority races, Senate District 15, voters chose OLCV-endorsed challenger Myrna Muñoz over a well-funded, corporate-backed incumbent. Myrna was inspired to run over proposed data center construction in her community and will be a climate and environmental champion in the legislature.
Across our priority races, we’re seeing positive results in nearly 73% of the races we invested in .These wins prove something important: when we organize, mobilize voters, and invest in bold climate leadership, we win.
This cycle, OLCV staff and volunteers knocked on more than 6,300 doors and contacted over 10,000 voters directly to help build support for candidates who will fight for climate action, accountability, and Oregon communities.
But, our work is far from over. The general election is just around the corner, and corporate interests are already preparing to spend heavily to stop climate progress in Oregon.
We have momentum on our side, but we need the resources to keep going.
Will you make a contribution of $50 today to help OLCV elect even more climate champions in November? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/LkZV8_ZZqEK8PaX3vGWyPQ2] Your gift will allow us to recruit 3 new volunteers to speak to voters in the fall!
Give now [https://secure.ngpvan.com/LkZV8_ZZqEK8PaX3vGWyPQ2?am=20&amtOpts=&is_optimized_ask=true&contactdata=d/vHrdjKripIyJvqlK1Nls0dRqWFYvxUf/cVgpnAHt+nSzlsJ3/iaeHBpsFBtsdIPSpGuh5hG157cfiboCoWOsmcvqjqpm+mmkn/KVVsyTIf81oT83/+Capxf5i0bFC5]
Your support will help us reach more voters, expand our organizing efforts, and continue building a stronger climate movement across Oregon.
Make your investment in climate leadership now. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/LkZV8_ZZqEK8PaX3vGWyPQ2] Thank you for being part of this work.
In solidarity,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Sarah%20Signature.png]
Sarah Kline (she/they)
OLCV Communications & Membership Coordinator

name: Phil Scott
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Phil Scott for Vermont
body:
More work to do |
---
| | [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/FJuLd8G2od_?e=19cebfe173&c2id=84d1094b3a168b6495ef78aca9f3540c)
---
| Friend,
---
| It has been the honor of my life to serve as Governor.

Over the years, we’ve been through a lot together.

Every day, I do my best to provide steady, positive leadership, focused on affordability and restoring economic opportunities in every corner of our state.

After carefully considering the challenges ahead for our state and nation, and the work I’d like to see through before leaving office, I have decided to seek another term as your Governor.

This was not a decision I made lightly, but make no mistake, even with all the headwinds, I’m as motivated as ever to make Vermont more affordable, advocate for more common sense in the Legislature, and work with anyone who’s willing to work with me, to make Vermont a better place.

After many years of public service, I believe most Vermonter appreciate my work ethic, and if you elect me to another term, I’ll do all I can to leave Vermont in better shape than I found it. That’s how I’ve approached every challenge in my life.

Over the next two years, I’ll continue to fight for policies that will make every community stronger, more affordable, and more vibrant.

I’m incredibly grateful for the support and trust you’ve provided me over the years. Together, we’ve shown that good government, balanced leadership, and a relentless focus on real results can still bring people together, regardless of political party.

There is more to do, and I’m ready to continue our work together.

Sincerely,

Gov. Phil

name: Scott Brown
subject: I've been training for this my whole life
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Brown for New Hampshire, Inc
body:
Peter,

You may not know this, but two months ago I had knee surgery.

Last week I rode my bike for 30 minutes. Most I've done since the operation.
Very little pain. The swelling's finally gone.

And honestly? I can't wait to get back out there full throttle this week.

I know that probably sounds crazy to some people. But this is just what I do.

<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/recovery-email-prsp-afs?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_afs&utm_campaign=20260528_recovery-email_sb&xfls=3jcHEuGlu2D5R53k>
I've been doing triathlons for DECADES — early mornings, long miles, grinding
through the moments when your body tells you to quit, and your mind has to take
over. It's not a hobby. It's a discipline. It's how I'm wired.

And it's exactly how I'm running this Senate campaign.

People ask me how I handle the attacks, the outside money, the DC
establishment working against me. Honestly? I've been training for this my
whole life – literally. When you've pushed through the back half of a triathlon
on empty, when you've learned to embrace the pain instead of running from it,
political heat doesn't rattle you the way it rattles career politicians.

That's the difference between me and the typical candidate. I don't just talk
about being tough. I train for it. Every single week. Even when I'm still
recovering from surgery.

Democrats have me in their crosshairs because they know I can flip this New
Hampshire seat.

The establishment is coming at me because I've never been their guy — I don't
play their games, I don't owe them favors, and I won't back down when things
get hard.

They're banking on me folding. They don't know me very well.

Will you chip in $10, $25, or $50 today and show them what this team is made
of?

Meanwhile, families across Maryland are struggling with the cost of groceries, housing, childcare, and everyday essentials.
