That’s why this campaign matters so much to me.

With how much people are struggling, the fact that this campaign still receives grassroots support is all the more proof of how much trust people have in me. People are chipping in what they can — not because it’s easy, but because they believe in what we’re fighting for.

| | This month, I filed for reelection, and I have been hard at work fighting for Northwest Washington's values in Congress. **Representing Northwest Washington is a privilege I do not take for granted.** **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132256436/623914942/1596212816?refcode=2026-05-28-may&recurring=&amount=7&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=24c171c3-cc5a-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNGMxNzFjMy1jYzVhLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VmFiZLgUP2p_NSUTK6uImEfhpYW3H7EVISnLnA5ao4s=)****Ensuring access to abortion and reproductive health care** Earlier this month, I joined more than 250 House and Senate Democrats in filing an amicus brief urging the Supreme Court to overturn a Fifth Circuit decision that would restrict access to Mifepristone by reinstating a requirement that the drug be dispensed in person. As a member of Congress with a 100% voting record on choice, I will always fight for access to abortion and reproductive health care nationwide. **Fighting the Opioid Crisis in Northwest Washington** This month, I co-introduced the End Fentanyl Trafficking with Local Task Forces Act. This bipartisan legislation would establish a dedicated federal funding stream to help multi-jurisdictional drug task forces combat opioid trafficking in Washington state and across the country. I am focused on supporting local law enforcement in their fight against the opioid epidemic. In 2024, I published a districtwide opioid report that outlines a four-pillar framework to combat the crisis. Since the publication of that report, I have introduced four pieces of legislation to fight fentanyl in Northwest Washington:
* **The PROTECT Act** , which gives Tribal courts and law enforcement more tools and resources to combat the opioid epidemic.
* **The Workforce Opportunities for Communities in Recovery Act** , which creates employment opportunities for people in recovery and supports communities impacted by widespread opioid use.
* **The End Fentanyl Trafficking with Local Task Forces Act** , which establishes a dedicated federal funding stream to help multi-jurisdictional drug task forces combat opioid trafficking in Washington state and across the country.
* **The Closing the Substance Use Care Gap Act** , which expands access to lifesaving, community-based harm reduction initiatives and services and enhances the federal response to the opioid and fentanyl epidemic.

**Secured new flood recovery funds for Whatcom County** FEMA announced the release of $3.7 million in Hazard Mitigation Grant Program (HMGP) funds for homeowners in Everson, Lynden, Ferndale, and Bellingham to support buyouts for flood-damaged homes. This $3.7 million is great news for Whatcom County families. These dollars will directly help local folks get back on track after the devastating floods in November 2021. I am glad the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) released these long-overdue funds. I will keep fighting for federal dollars to help Northwest Washington communities recover from natural disasters and prepare for future disasters. [**Northwest Washington guides my work in Congress, and I will always continue to fight for our values. clean_body: This month, I filed for reelection, and I have been hard at work fighting for Northwest Washington’s values in Congress. | | | | This month, I filed for reelection, and I have been hard at work fighting for Northwest Washington's values in Congress. Representing Northwest Washington is a privilege I do not take for granted. access to abortion and reproductive health care Earlier this month, I joined more than 250 House and Senate Democrats in filing an amicus brief urging the Supreme Court to overturn a Fifth Circuit decision that would restrict access to Mifepristone by reinstating a requirement that the drug be dispensed in person. As a member of Congress with a 100% voting record on choice, I will always fight for access to abortion and reproductive health care nationwide. Fighting the Opioid Crisis in Northwest Washington This month, I co-introduced the End Fentanyl Trafficking with Local Task Forces Act. This bipartisan legislation would establish a dedicated federal funding stream to help multi-jurisdictional drug task forces combat opioid trafficking in Washington state and across the country. I am focused on supporting local law enforcement in their fight against the opioid epidemic. In 2024, I published a districtwide opioid report that outlines a four-pillar framework to combat the crisis. Since the publication of that report, I have introduced four pieces of legislation to fight fentanyl in Northwest Washington: The PROTECT Act , which gives Tribal courts and law enforcement more tools and resources to combat the opioid epidemic. The Workforce Opportunities for Communities in Recovery Act , which creates employment opportunities for people in recovery and supports communities impacted by widespread opioid use. The End Fentanyl Trafficking with Local Task Forces Act , which establishes a dedicated federal funding stream to help multi-jurisdictional drug task forces combat opioid trafficking in Washington state and across the country. The Closing the Substance Use Care Gap Act , which expands access to lifesaving, community-based harm reduction initiatives and services and enhances the federal response to the opioid and fentanyl epidemic. Secured new flood recovery funds for Whatcom County FEMA announced the release of $3.7 million in Hazard Mitigation Grant Program (HMGP) funds for homeowners in Everson, Lynden, Ferndale, and Bellingham to support buyouts for flood-damaged homes. This $3.7 million is great news for Whatcom County families. These dollars will directly help local folks get back on track after the devastating floods in November 2021. I am glad the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) released these long-overdue funds. subject: National Republicans are nervous about these chambers
body:
If these states look familiar, it’s because they are the same states we’re targeting this year
#
The Republican State Leadership Committee (RSLC) — the Republican arm for state legislative races — just released a memo laying out some of its **top targets** for 2026:
[](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22739?t=1&akid=1642%2E2118727%2EuBNQDu)
If these states look familiar, it’s because they are the **same states** we’re targeting this year, and they spell out exactly why they’re mobilizing in these states in their memo:
_“If Republicans lose even a handful of these seats, Democrats will gain the power to redraw congressional maps in multiple battleground states, locking in structural advantages that could last the rest of the decade and dramatically narrowing the path to a Republican House majority in Congress.” — RSLC_
Republicans are nervous about losing these races because they understand that control of state legislatures in these targeted states will shape what happens long after Election Day — _from congressional maps to voting laws to who holds power in Washington._
**That’s why, while political attention has been focused on federal races, States Win is laser-focused on electing bold Democratic voices in high-stakes races like these this November.**
But Republicans are boosting their efforts to win state power right now.
**[That’s why we need your help to out-organize them, help our candidates build competitive campaigns, and flip seats. Will you join States Win to support our efforts today?](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22739?t=2&akid=1642%2E2118727%2EuBNQDu)**
**[Join Us ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22739?t=3&akid=1642%2E2118727%2EuBNQDu)**
Winning a few seats in these states could change everything, but we can’t do it without you.
Thank you,
— States Win

The Trump administration is escalating its attacks on free and fair elections. But Oregon is fighting back. Here’s how:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
Recently, the Department of Justice sued me for refusing to hand over sensitive voter information, including driver’s license numbers, Social Security numbers, and birthdays.
I said no.
And I’ll keep saying no. Because protecting the integrity of our elections also means protecting the privacy and rights of Oregon voters.
The truth is, Oregon’s elections are secure . Our vote-by-mail system works . Our county clerks work tirelessly to ensure every eligible voter can cast a ballot safely and securely.
But instead of strengthening democracy, President Donald Trump and his allies are trying to undermine confidence in elections and make it harder for Americans to vote.
I believe Oregon has a responsibility to stand firm when the federal government overreaches or demands unconstitutional access to private voter data.
That fight is ongoing.
So I’m asking: will you chip in today to help me continue defending voting rights, election integrity, and the rule of law here in Oregon? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
The so-called SAVE Act is a perfect example. It’s being sold as “election security,” but in reality, it would make voting harder for millions of eligible Americans — including rural voters, seniors, students, tribal communities, and married women whose names may not match old documents.
That’s not protecting democracy. That’s restricting it.
And I believe we should make it easier for eligible citizens to vote — not harder.
At moments like this, steady leadership matters.
We don’t need panic or political theater. We need people willing to stand up, tell the truth, and protect our democracy even when it’s difficult.
That’s exactly what I intend to keep doing. If you’re with me, please make a donation today – any amount makes a difference. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]

# [Mamdani vs. Spanberger shows the stakes of Democrats' civil war](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=4981170&post_id=199497660&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk5NDk3NjYwLCJpYXQiOjE3Nzk5OTgxMDQsImV4cCI6MTc4MjU5MDEwNCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTQ5ODExNzAiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.0h-rimcQRQyjKnlSobMRjeLPo-7ciUR2GFl0rCGoBOc)
### To understand the existential nature of the fight to control the Democratic Party, just compare Zohran's term so far with Spanberger's.
| | [Aaron Regunberg](https://substack.com/@aaronregunberg)

---

Since Donald Trump's reelection, progressive and moderate Democrats have spent a lot of time fighting over differences in their approaches to campaign messaging and strategy. But the differences that matter most are those that occur after an election, when it's time to govern. There's no better example than the emerging contrast between New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Virginia Governor Abigail Spanberger--one a democratic socialist, the other a centrist former CIA agent--who both rode affordability messages into office last year. Though they have been in office only five months, their respective records demonstrate the true stakes of the factional battle over the future of the Democratic Party.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..qnK3Ry_y1wvrjRtMfuNNxNolpvT4YbUQVEXLomPlFuQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=199497660)
After the 2025 elections, corporate-backed establishment groups like [Third Way](https://substack.com/redirect/9c0f08a1-955e-4a7c-a877-e3425828e1e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [WelcomePAC](https://substack.com/redirect/30058322-7426-420b-b7b1-539242ee0b9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) argued vehemently that Mamdani's win offered few if any lessons for Democrats outside of New York City, and that the real attention should be on politicians like Spanberger. Just last week, Clinton strategist Paul Begala reiterated this message, saying in an [interview](https://substack.com/redirect/b8b14e34-56d7-4317-9975-14db08b78a3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with NPR that Mamdani had "the weakest performance of a successful Democrat in New York in a hundred years," whereas "in a state where the Republicans were controlling every statewide office, Abigail Spanberger wins in a landslide."
This oft-repeated talking point is easily debunked. Zohran Mamdani won the votes of [more New Yorkers](https://substack.com/redirect/6c372953-ced9-4714-8fd6-a0eedb65d908?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than any mayoral candidate in over 50 years. Though his 51 percent vote share wouldn't be particularly impressive if he had just been running against a Republican, that wasn't the lineup he faced. Mamdani ran against both a Republican and former Democratic Governor Andrew Cuomo, scion of a famous Democratic dynasty, who was boosted by a tsunami of billionaire super PAC spending. The apples-to-apples comparison here would be if Spanberger had faced not just the GOP's gubernatorial nominee but also a former Democratic governor like Ralph Northam or Terry McAuliffe.
As it is, in her one-on-one race, Spanberger earned close to 58 percent. That sounds impressive--even though she was facing an extremely [weak](https://substack.com/redirect/dba3689b-a4e0-4c86-9fdf-0b8fa9bcf9a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Republican opponent--until you learn that this was the [exact](https://substack.com/redirect/44becbbf-a250-47e7-b659-a11a4b56287c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) vote share that Democrats won in the Virginia House of Delegates. It turns out Spanberger didn't receive 58 percent because she's an electoral overperformer--she received 58 percent because she was running with a _D_ next to her name in a state with a long record of swerving hard against the party in control of the governor's mansion and White House, months after DOGE had [laid off](https://substack.com/redirect/0f04f198-41e7-44c8-99d1-66303a31b56d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) tens of thousands of Virginians.
Whatever their margins of victory, both Mamdani and Spanberger won their elections. So what have these Democratic executives actually done with their time in office?
Mamdani's first six months have been a [whirlwind](https://substack.com/redirect/d2663248-4dd3-402a-955d-21bab4eb4b86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of action to reinvigorate the institutions of city government and demonstrate to New Yorkers that Democratic governance can make a positive material impact in their lives. To list a few of these achievements, the Mamdani administration:
* Established [free childcare](https://substack.com/redirect/e470aa34-5f5b-4152-968d-cf40aba33382?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for 2-year-olds.
* [Targeted](https://substack.com/redirect/8ae7a75b-ba90-4717-9e20-e2a703d9e2a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) junk fees and subscription traps.
* Announced new [rec centers](https://substack.com/redirect/5d25bd3a-e0a6-485c-a92f-6878baef8e6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [youth clinics](https://substack.com/redirect/d8626de1-217a-4f72-a5b1-33fc0605b1d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [early childhood education centers](https://substack.com/redirect/1dcb43e5-8f40-4d00-a90c-b2cb64e22275?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Developed new [bike](https://substack.com/redirect/b202e88b-ee58-4626-98b7-ac84a0c9ecd7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [bus](https://substack.com/redirect/6079ac20-3622-40fc-8f8d-317868871705?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) lanes across the city.
* Invested $50 million in [park improvements](https://substack.com/redirect/98d2410e-c35d-43a7-bd3d-ea4c5fef3ca8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Created a new [Office of Community Safety](https://substack.com/redirect/aabf850f-0ac5-4919-83cc-0414608eea17?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and the [Mayor's Office to Protect Tenants](https://substack.com/redirect/c1e30885-9536-4b31-b3d7-109e28530cb7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which has [already](https://substack.com/redirect/e6a75a27-ec8b-4886-aa8d-3139c90f1019?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) won over $34 million on behalf of tenants and secured repairs at over 6,000 apartments across the city.
* Launched "[rental ripoff hearings](https://substack.com/redirect/f34879a6-0893-4a0b-adda-d9a2a3f4428d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" to provide tenants an opportunity to register complaints with city officials.
* Filled [100,000 potholes](https://substack.com/redirect/91993482-81e0-44b4-9515-84c2d86632a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Established a [program](https://substack.com/redirect/75c1b819-2848-4e17-9af5-d192abc1a123?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to quickly remove unnecessary sidewalk scaffolding.
* Secured a [wealth tax](https://substack.com/redirect/e5072b36-f967-4c37-9a0e-c3a34d9e46de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on luxury second homes.
* Cut [hundreds of millions](https://substack.com/redirect/3b913fbc-5610-4752-bd0c-fa6e187ba514?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of dollars in waste, fraud, and abuse.
* Closed an inherited $12 billion budget deficit to [deliver](https://substack.com/redirect/d38cce8b-d02a-4d2c-a0c3-d49914e5160c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a balanced city budget.

Mamdani's administration has communicated these achievements to the public in innovative and attention-grabbing ways, telling a story of government actually making things better. Here's how Mamdani [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/6f677ab8-74ba-4795-8ce8-b7e28506d53c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) plans for his administration's first city-owned grocery store:
"This store will serve as physical proof of our conviction that government can be a force for good--that government can drive change that improves people's lives. And standing here this morning, I cannot help but think of the words of our fortieth president, Ronald Reagan. He famously said, 'The nine most terrifying words in the English language are: I'm from the government and I'm here to help.' It's a good quote, but I disagree. I think nine more terrifying words are actually, 'I worked all day and can't feed my family.' We are going to use the power of government to lower prices and make it easier for New Yorkers to put food on the table. When government understands its purpose as serving the very working people that it has left behind time and again, it can make a difference in the most pressing struggles facing our city today. It's not just that government can help; it's that government must help and our government will help."
This message is about more than stoking one politician's popularity. It is laying the groundwork for a new narrative of public-sector action--one that can supplant the right's decades-long effort to persuade Americans that government is the problem. Convincing the public of this narrative is a necessary step toward establishing a durable governing majority for any left or center-left party.
The right, by contrast, thrives when the public believes that government can't deliver for regular people. That's why Spanberger's recent conduct is so devastating. Not only has she been failing to enact an ambitious agenda, but she has been actively blocking efforts to pass major Democratic priorities in Virginia, [vetoing](https://substack.com/redirect/de25aa77-fa25-4884-a855-e9387d98a27b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a series of bills sent to her by her own party's legislative majorities.
Spanberger vetoed legislation giving Virginia's public workers the right to unionize. This betrayal inspired a wave of condemnation from organized labor, including the Virginia Public Sector Labor Coalition, which [stated](https://substack.com/redirect/4b1e9e7b-c3a1-48e0-bd0d-f56308a49fa3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "Governor Spanberger today betrayed half a million of Virginia's public service workers by going back on her campaign promise to support collective bargaining rights for the people who keep our communities running every day. Instead of aligning herself with General Assembly Democrats who unanimously supported this bill, Spanberger vetoed the bill just as her predecessor Glenn Youngkin did, sending Virginia workers the crystal clear message that they are no better off than they were under a Republican governor."
Spanberger vetoed legislation creating the right to class-action lawsuits, a legal mechanism for seeking redress against malicious corporate conduct that exists in every state but Virginia and Mississippi. Right-wing business groups [celebrated](https://substack.com/redirect/9cf7220e-ddf8-4bb6-9374-1d3781696c4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) her move, while consumer [advocates](https://substack.com/redirect/aa543c5b-b5c4-48d9-b2f0-edbd9b4889ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) were deeply stung. As the bill's Senate sponsor [said](https://substack.com/redirect/5068c3dd-cfb9-4209-bab0-a6c1d91dee51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "This legislation was about leveling the playing field between Virginia consumers and large corporations when widespread harm occurs but no single individual has the resources to fight back alone."
Spanberger vetoed legislation to stop ICE from conducting warrantless arrests in state-run facilities, leaving immigrants in the state afraid to go to courts or hospitals or to take their children to school. In the [words](https://substack.com/redirect/f877b673-de7c-4e73-adc2-2b945d1c3501?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the ACLU of Virginia's policy director, "The governor's position seems to be that if ICE wants to do whatever it wants to do in our courthouses, they can, and that the state's not going to do anything about that. That sends a terribly dangerous message to the Trump administration when we know that they have acted rogue and lawlessly."
Spanberger vetoed legislation creating a legal retail market for recreational marijuana in Virginia, an issue that has [supermajority support](https://substack.com/redirect/4da2a04e-6533-4a93-9f05-168f86d89bf8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the state. "We're left in a position of uncertainty," [said](https://substack.com/redirect/2fcd7f6a-f146-47e2-b10f-1de677454b97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the bill's Senate sponsor, "for my community, for small-business owners, and particularly for those individuals who thought that under a Democratic governor the question of cannabis would not be a matter of if, but instead a matter of when."
Spanberger vetoed legislation that would have lowered prescription drug prices for patients by extending Medicare's negotiated drug prices to people in private health plans and Medicaid. This pleased corporate lobbying groups like the Pharmaceutical Manufacturers of America, who [lauded](https://substack.com/redirect/94513859-2ca2-4d10-9ce3-1547ba2cf344?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Spanberger for taking "the right step to protect Virginia patients from a flawed policy." Meanwhile, patient and consumer advocates were crushed, with the director of the affordable health care organization Families USA [saying](https://substack.com/redirect/177b417e-fe53-4256-8e67-2baf6409f7c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "Governor Spanberger's veto is a blow to Virginia families who struggle every day to afford their medications."
Spanberger also vetoed legislation to [stop](https://substack.com/redirect/a49923be-8c43-451e-a3e0-07f99adfc3a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) illegitimate purges of voter rolls, [protect](https://substack.com/redirect/a4938132-3d5a-44df-a090-63f72026e66e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) defendants with behavioral health issues, and [shield](https://substack.com/redirect/7a3a2272-7bba-4647-b5d1-2b24bbe57fca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) universities from speech restrictions like those pushed by Trump. This end-of-session legislative massacre is a substantive disaster for Virginia's workers, consumers, immigrants, patients, and other communities, who have lost not just an opportunity but perhaps _their only_ opportunity to get their priorities enacted, given the reality that Democrats cannot count on maintaining a trifecta over state government for long.
But it's also a political disaster for Democrats. In the short term, it risks suppressing enthusiasm among all the constituencies Spanberger betrayed. As Virginia Tech political analyst Dr. Cayce Myers [put it](https://substack.com/redirect/c9521733-7e37-40fd-8673-84fef8bded67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "You certainly could envision a situation where people say, 'Well, you know, this was something that they promised, but they weren't able to deliver.' And they're less enthusiastic, writ large, about going and voting."
But the long-term effects of this pro-corporate governance could be even more dangerous. Spanberger has sent millions of Virginians the message that Republicans and Democrats are all the same.
For many liberals, it's hard to grasp how anyone could believe there's no difference between the parties. But if you're a senior struggling to afford your prescriptions, or a public worker who's sick and tired of crappy benefits, and you see Democratic Governor Spanberger issue the exact same veto of your top priority as Republican Governor Youngkin did, benefiting the exact same corporate special interests, it's not actually that crazy to say, "None of these crooks are looking out for me; screw 'em all."
This is political poison--not just for Democrats, but for democracy. After all, if all these politicians are crooks, and our democratic institutions can't seem to effect any real change, why not throw in with a strongman who promises to blow the whole corrupt system sky-high?
Trump was defeated in 2020, only to return in an even more dangerous form four years later. So we already know that it is not enough to beat MAGA once at the ballot box. If Democrats do not pair their next electoral victory with a strong record of governance--one that reflects the Mamdani commitment to positively improving people's lives, not the Spanberger model of selling out to corporations--we are going to be right back in the maws of fascism one election later. And this time, we might not be facing an authoritarian as incompetent and self-defeating as Trump has been.

**Doris Matsui, who’s represented Sacramento for _over 20 years,_ is boosting a Republican to stop Justice Democrat Mai Vang from unseating her in Tuesday’s Democratic primary.**

| | Peter, It's Mike.
I just got our latest numbers, and I have to be honest with you, _we are coming up short_ of our _**May End-of-Month goal**_. Not by a lot. By a few thousand dollars.
And that's what's eating at me.

But our _**May End-of-Month**_ _**deadline**_ is **midnight, Sunday, May 31st** , just three days away, and we are a few thousand dollars from where we need to be.
A few thousand dollars. That's the whole gap.
_When our numbers are posted publicly, the DCCC and every Democrat lining up for this seat will be reading them to decide how hard to come at us this summer. _

**Peter** , my daughter is running out of time. I’m hoping that if you can spare just a minute or two, you can help turn things around for her. Because the truth is, **_she can’t do this _without you.__** My name is Anne, and I’m a retired school teacher. I spent most of my life taking care of children. **But the one that matters most—my daughter, Nancy Mace—well, she’s fighting a battle that I can’t fight for her.** **Right now, all I can do to help is reach out to _faithful patriots like you_ for support.** But first, _in order for all of this to make sense_ , I need to tell you a story, Peter. **At 17, Nancy dropped out of high school.** Her friends attended graduation in their caps and gowns... As a teacher, it broke my heart. As a mom, I feared she’d never recover. _But that’s the thing about Nancy._ In the end, it didn’t matter that she didn’t graduate. **Because she listened to the #1 lesson I taught her, and it didn’t come from a book.** **_Never give up._** My daughter wasn’t born with a silver spoon. | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

| | | | | | Peter,
Looking for fun plans this weekend? Well, you’re in luck, because **we need your help knocking on doors!**
We have two opportunities where you can join our team to talk to voters about Nick and get out the vote before Tuesday’s critical election. Brief training will be provided, so just bring walking shoes and a fully charged phone.
On Saturday, we’ll be in [**Mar Vista**](https://us.list-manage.com/oIw41QBelOh?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba)**** starting at 10 AM. You can sign up [here](https://us.list-manage.com/HJzzTAch7gl?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba).
On Sunday, we’ll be at [**EncinoFest**](https://us.list-manage.com/A5HUPjbPS2s?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba) , an exciting community event where we can talk to Valley voters. If you’re not inclined to knock doors and want to just meet people where they’re at, this is a great event for you! You can sign up [here](https://us.list-manage.com/BVilWQJoS6q?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba).
If you can’t make it to either, but want to help get Nick over the finish line either through knocking or calling or texting people, you can email me at [alex@nickmelvoin.com](mailto:alex@nickmelvoin.com?subject=Canvassing&body=) and I can get you all set up!
**Nick spends his days helping the kids of LA, and now it’s our chance to help him.** I hope you’ll join us this weekend!
-Alex

Dear Friend,

Imagine this: It's a dark night in Newark, New Jersey. A young officer, just 26 years old, father of four, races to back up his brothers in blue. A dangerous chase unfolds – armed thugs in a speeding car, weaving through streets at 70 mph the wrong way, endangering innocent families. These criminals point a loaded semi-automatic right at Officer Jovanny Crespo's face. They try to mow him down like roadkill. In a split-second decision, the kind no desk-jockey prosecutor could ever understand, Officer Crespo acts to protect himself, his fellow officers, and the public. He stops the threat. Lives are saved. But what does he get in return? Handcuffs. Indictment. A sham trial where he's branded a "murderer" and "killer" by radicals who hate the badge. | [Help Free JOVANNY](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=67e937c2b3d34a17acad9c9f9a7269a4&_e=85g0-JH0YIxD7CJVqBFfcd8m-80NySOytTIEaS-AdAY71MZ8igLyObH7JqiA_YgoHWwNoSJbb8y60cynuw_o6oCWcYN5Y3uK7mFJirMGNFd8Tz3snswCandV0lrf2hgyViVz5rm-Bnsjh8ToMCI_nAUuzwwvQbaLMifbAY-EXFNXjYgKVFnw70mgfK9E4xWxli7gY1ImzwEI9y7wKy4py03V8hbD5EcbCGmeZs-7HqSaEyyz7NdGGcqjbuvwNsLjCW0Zpj7E-DdetFLBTaLvEaw9Cgl58dalXwUvQeKXWP96EOUhB6GGE4V_72RWkFU_gX5qz3EY0CaGrj8SdfXvti_5bwWn-m7IlH6TF66lYUwuWeM_Gt3VxBsy9VX--vz8-Zc55JEGtxpv1eOE5ML-8PqvP7F0jTpnGr69cM84q7NFmrn__EwTqMBAvw167WIM)
---

_Jovanny and his children_

That's right. Officer Crespo was slapped with aggravated manslaughter charges, found guilty, and sentenced to a staggering 27 YEARS behind bars. Twenty-seven years! For doing his job. While the real criminals—drug-pushing, gun-waving menaces—get a free pass in the court of public opinion.
This isn't justice. This is a witch hunt. Anti-police zealots are weaponizing the system to destroy heroes like Jovanny. He's lost his pay, his freedom, and now fights for his life in appeals court. His four kids? They grow up without their dad because some ivory-tower elites decided cops are the enemy.
[Rush $25 to Defend Jovanny](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=67e937c2b3d34a17acad9c9f9a7269a4&_e=85g0-JH0YIxD7CJVqBFfcd8m-80NySOytTIEaS-AdAY71MZ8igLyObH7JqiA_YgoHWwNoSJbb8y60cynuw_o6oCWcYN5Y3uK7mFJirMGNFcKEydjB6UlshmWwlYmPHFMNB4C-vJUHJCb3FkZK5-V9zpn-U-yxLzcbCYh1bc72Sr2ZaE399fbqLAmPkZhVN23MBjbvv7bNXsDL-gAY7j8RMW9LDI9jFqOFPXL8FuUWJ0OSFxeocdyYM-a9qL45MrFaelY7MxBnUJSeW8I9Xy75G3LeKYaySSCcwbGzY4f3G8BEqUySP4SaKNDoryJ_WakjBKyz8_D_iWQfH5SPCImEIymPYNrC6BJzVMEUv2Y0Gwah7Luht3fAc-cTNyk1LaVjWb3Tp_cg3gAl4SBOSO56G9UNEaNX45JZSmOcvainey6oHddRAgHNMVyJPXi7aRC)
---
I've seen this garbage firsthand. As America's Toughest Sheriff, I locked up the bad guys and stood tall against the liberal mob. Now, the National Center for Police Defense is stepping up for Officer Crespo – funding his appeal, supporting his family, and battling this grave injustice. But we can't do it alone.
Your donation today fuels the fight. It says, "Enough!" to the war on cops. It ensures brave officers like Jovanny get the defense they deserve, not the betrayal they endure.

body:
Waking up to this every day is absolutely infuriating.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260528-1&t=1&akid=3535%2E587540%2EFZXTip)
Peter,
**Waking up every day to watch this administration dismantle our democracy piece by piece is absolutely infuriating.**
And honestly, we don’t have the luxury of playing nice and waiting around for the rest of the Democratic Party to wake the hell up. Not when the fights we’re up against are this dire.
Trump is waging an illegal war in Iran that has already cost Americans an estimated $30 billion and counting. Gas is getting higher by the minute, grocery bills keep climbing, and millions of people can’t afford to go to the doctor. Working families are being left to survive a corrupt political system that continues to put the wealthy and powerful first.
This is the moment to go all in. We have to fight back on every front, with every tool at our disposal, and do more than just react. **We have to build.**
That means organizing against the most vulnerable Republicans and making it clear that there is a real political price to pay for enabling Trump’s dangerous agenda.
It means primarying asleep-at-the-wheel Democrats — because if they’re not fighting with us, they’re in the way.
And it means we have to turn the fracturing of Trump’s base into an opportunity — because young voters are souring on him, they’re feeling betrayed, and the window to offer them a vision worth believing in is _right now_.

Peter — It's Becca! Okay, I have to be honest with you: My team showed me the tracker this morning, and honestly, it gave me a real JOLT of hope. **We set a goal to raise $2,500 before 11:59 PM on May 31st and thanks to this incredible grassroots team, we’re already 39% of the way there!** That’s a STRONG start — but we’re not at the finish line just yet. With only 3 days left, this is the moment to try to keep the bar moving! [_**So I’m taking a quick break from a packed day to ask you personally: Will you check out our LIVE tracker and chip in a few bucks to help move the bar closer to our $2,500 goal if you can?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132261006/623926015/687249952?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMGE2YWI1OS1kNDVhLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4ydt-B1MT5mMLTA-zs4fXvEAShTwlKJ_avIp40C2a_I=) **[CHECK THE TRACKER + CHIP IN](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132261007/623926016/687249952?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMGE2YWI1OS1kNDVhLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4ydt-B1MT5mMLTA-zs4fXvEAShTwlKJ_avIp40C2a_I=)** I know campaign emails can sometimes feel like a lot. Believe me, I get it. But underneath the tracker, the deadline, and the fundraising goal is the reason we’re doing this in the first place. **I’m a former history teacher, and I don’t say this lightly: What we are living through right now is going to take generations to repair.** When people no longer believe we can have free and fair elections, when they don’t know what information to trust from their own government, when a sitting president lies to the American people about things big and small — that damage runs deep. **And the way we come back from it is not by throwing up our hands. clean_body: She raised me to stand up to bullies and cheaters. That's exactly what we're doing. | | | | | Hi Peter, My mom always taught me that you stand up to bullies and cheaters. This was my first Mother's Day without her, and I’ve thought about her a lot throughout this campaign, in the quiet moments between events, on my morning runs, and sitting with my family in the church pew on Sunday. I think she would be proud of what we are building together. And I know she would be furious about what the legislature did to slap Tennessee voters in the face by changing the rules of the election and creating chaos. They redrew the maps after the deadlines had already passed. Thousands of people poured their hearts and souls into this campaign and this movement, knocking doors, and making calls — voters who believed their voice mattered went out and made it heard. And then the politicians in Nashville looked at all of that and decided to just wipe it away for their own benefit. My mom would have called that exactly what it is: bullying. Cheating. And wrong. So we joined a lawsuit. Because what's right is right and what's wrong is wrong, and this is wrong. Let's talk about Scott DesJarlais. **He has been sitting in Washington for over a decade.** In that time, what has he actually delivered for the working people of Tennessee? For _any American?_ While your grocery bills skyrocket, prescription drug costs climb, and local wages stagnate, DesJarlais has consistently voted to protect corporate tax loopholes and mega-donors.
**I don 't know about you, but I have had enough of these kinds of candidates, and I am running to start right here. [Are you with me?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4db59dd2-0ad5-4230-a74b-11fe26415777?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/30b24b7a-85ff-4302-8410-667089b16a47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Pitch in $20.26 to flip this seat 2026!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4db59dd2-0ad5-4230-a74b-11fe26415777?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It is the classic Washington playbook: say one thing back home, and then vote directly against the interests of your constituents the second you step foot inside the Beltway. **He has become the definition of a political sellout, inline with his party 's platform of course.**
I didn't enter public service to climb a career ladder. On the Nashville Metro Council, I've focused on the gritty, real-world issues affecting local families: housing, budgets, and public investments. Friends,
Congresswoman Doris Matsui has spent her career fighting for the people of California. I’m proud to throw my support behind her in her race for re-election in the 7th District – and I’m hoping you’ll join me.
Doris has represented Sacramento in Congress for over two decades, and in that time, she has delivered billions of dollars in federal investments for flood protection, clean energy jobs, expanded health care access, and modernized infrastructure for her region. She has fought for safer levees, lower prescription drug costs, and expanded mental health care and telehealth.
Doris has a primary on June 2, and she needs our support between now and then. Will you split a donation between Doris’s campaign and mine today to help her win in June and help us take back the House in November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em-matsui?amount=50]
CONTRIBUTE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em-matsui?amount=50]
Doris was born in an internment camp after the federal government forcibly removed her parents and grandparents from the lives they built in California in 1942, part of the horrific mass incarceration of Japanese Americans during World War II.
She knows how fragile our freedoms can be, and her experience shapes how she approaches her work every day: with a commitment to building a government that works for the people , protects the most vulnerable among us, and safeguards our civil and human rights.
And she has backed that up with her record – taking on the Trump administration when they have attacked climate protections, treated immigrants as second-class citizens, and overstepped the bounds of their power over and over again.
Doris has never stopped working to hold this administration accountable, and that's exactly the kind of leader we need fighting for us right now.
Will you split a donation between Doris's campaign and mine today and help make sure she's back in Washington when we secure our Democratic majority? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em-matsui]

Because the threats to our fundamental freedoms aren't abstract. They have names. They have faces. They have voting records.

**Here are just three of the House Republicans we've put on notice:**

**Gabe Evans (CO-08)** has proven himself to be a reliable rubber stamp for the MAGA agenda — including voting for Medicaid cuts that could put over **30,000** of his own constituents at risk of losing coverage.

**Mariannette Miller-Meeks (IA-01)** represents a district that reelected her by a fraction of a percent but her loyalty is only to Trump. It's so bad that when her constituents finally got a town hall to demand answers, they booed her off the stage. It's no surprise given that she votes with the Trump administration 100% of the time, and over her five years in the House, she's co-sponsored a total national abortion ban without exceptions, signed the amicus brief urging the Supreme Court to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , and voted against the Right to Contraception Act.

**Derrick Van Orden (WI-03)** is notorious for all the wrong reasons. He berated teenagers in the Capitol for taking pictures. He was a Jan. 6 attendee at the Capitol and continues to be an election denier. And instead of fighting for Wisconsinites, he’s pushed an agenda that benefits the wealthy and well-connected at everyone else's expense.

These three Republicans share a history of extremism, chaos, and putting Trump's agenda first. But they have something else in common, too:

**They're all vulnerable.**

But the House is only one part of the map. This week, we put 100 Republicans on notice across the House, Senate, governorships, state legislatures, statewide offices, and courts — because Republicans are using power at every level to attack our rights, raise costs, and stand in the way of progress.

clean_body: Meet the Trump loyalists our House candidates are ready to defeat. | = Peter, we talk a lot about what's at stake in 2026. Today, we want to highlight three races that are at the center of our plan to take back power. Because the threats to our fundamental freedoms aren't abstract. They have names. They have faces. They have voting records. = | = Here are just three of the House Republicans we've put on notice: Gabe Evans (CO-08) has proven himself to be a reliable rubber stamp for the MAGA agenda — including voting for Medicaid cuts that could put over 30,000 of his own constituents at risk of losing coverage. Mariannette Miller-Meeks (IA-01) represents a district that reelected her by a fraction of a percent but her loyalty is only to Trump. It's so bad that when her constituents finally got a town hall to demand answers, they booed her off the stage. It's no surprise given that she votes with the Trump administration 100% of the time, and over her five years in the House, she's co-sponsored a total national abortion ban without exceptions, signed the amicus brief urging the Supreme Court to overturn Roe v. Wade , and voted against the Right to Contraception Act. Derrick Van Orden (WI-03) is notorious for all the wrong reasons. He berated teenagers in the Capitol for taking pictures. He was a Jan. 6 attendee at the Capitol and continues to be an election denier. And instead of fighting for Wisconsinites, he’s pushed an agenda that benefits the wealthy and well-connected at everyone else's expense. These three Republicans share a history of extremism, chaos, and putting Trump's agenda first. But they have something else in common, too: They're all vulnerable. In the House, EMILYs List women like Shannon Bird (CO-08) , Christina Bohannan (IA-01) , and Rebecca Cooke (WI-03) are at the center of the fight to defeat these Trump loyalists and take back the U.S. House. But the House is only one part of the map. body:
https://elfrethformaryland.com/ [https://elfrethformaryland.com/]
Friend,

There are a lot of ways to get involved this election cycle, but the most fundamental one is making sure you're on the voter rolls.

Tuesday, June 2nd, is the last day to register to vote by mail or online.

Whether you recently moved to the district or just need to update your info after the last election cycle, it only takes about two minutes to make sure you’re set for the June 23rd primary. You can check your status or start a new registration here:

Check your registration status ➔ [https://elections.maryland.gov/elections/2026/vote2026/#election]

While Maryland still has same-day voter registration, it’s never too early to make a plan to vote. I’ve always believed that our government works best when more people are at the table. Ensuring your registration is current is the first step toward making that happen.

Thank you for being part of this.

Onward,

Sarah Elfreth

P.S. You may have seen that there was a vendor error with select Maryland ballots. If you are voting by mail and receive a second ballot that says "REPLACEMENT BALLOT," please make sure to fill out that ballot. For more information on replacement ballots, please call 410-269-2840, email absentee.SBE@maryland.gov [absentee.SBE@maryland.gov] , or CLICK HERE [https://elections.maryland.gov/elections/2026/2026_replacement_mib.html] .

Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. She went to Congress with one thing in mind: delivering for Maryland families on the issues that matter most. Whether it's standing up for federal workers, supporting veterans, protecting the Chesapeake Bay, or tackling the affordability crisis head-on, Sarah is on the front lines, fighting for what is right. And Sarah has delivered on her promises. She has spent her first year in the House advocating for the Third District, successfully passing five bills into law, solving over 1,000 constituent cases, and bringing tens of millions in funding back to her community. She learned her work ethic and tenacity from growing up in a union household and honed her skills of problem-solving and collaborating over six years in the Maryland State Senate. Sarah lives in Annapolis with her fiancé, Eric, and their dog, Ollie. Peter,
In 2023, our team conducted our first domestic rescue in California.
**A 12-year-old girl.** _Trafficked. Drugged. Raped. Held for 45 days in a homeless encampment under a bridge._
_**Our operators physically extracted her.** _
What it takes to be that team is what most people never see. The training. The intelligence work. The willingness to walk into a homeless encampment under a bridge knowing exactly what you might find and what you might have to do to bring a child out alive. The capacity to stay steady when the place you are going to is the worst place a 12-year-old has ever been.
**And underneath all of it, faith.** Our operators are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure before they ever set foot on a mission – because the work breaks anyone who walks into it without something stronger than their own will to fall back on. **We are the hands and feet of Jesus Christ in the field, and we have been since the day this organization started.** That is not a slogan. It is the load-bearing piece of how a team walks under that bridge and walks back out with a 12-year-old girl alive.
Thanks to God and the work of our operators, she made it home. Her family will never be the same. Neither will our team.
She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – _the next child is already missing._
**This is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments. Today, I write to you as the Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity.**

**We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Fast forward, and today we are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work most organizations cannot.**
In the last 90 days alone, our team has operated across three continents – efforts which entailed:
**✅ Eight American families extracted **from Mexico in February.

**✅ 33 American families and 155 additional Americans** assisted across Israel, Egypt, and Jordan in March.

**✅ 100,000+ meals distributed to individuals in desperate need in Haiti**.

**✅ Three more young teenage children rescued from trafficking situations** in Virginia and West Texas this January.
The work goes back further. **64 evacuated from Ukraine** during active combat in 2022. **58 Christians rescued from persecution** across Asia-Pacific and granted asylum.
For five years we have done all of this from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But the demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way.
**So we've just launched an intensive, nationwide capital campaign for the Heroes for Humanity National Training Center – a permanent home for the mission, right here in our home state of Texas.**
**The Training Center is a permanent facility built around the three pillars of our mission – precision personnel rescues, humanitarian and medical aid, and evangelism.** Standardized certification for every operator we put in the field. Medical and trauma training for austere and hostile environments. An OSINT and intelligence hub for ongoing mission planning. And the capacity to train the next generation of operators – at scale, under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure – for as long as the mission lasts.
**Total goal:** $1,000,000 by October.
**First milestone:** $100,000.
[ **Your generous commitment, right now, with a donation of any amount would be incredibly helpful. clean_body: What it takes to For five years, we have done this work from temporary facilities and borrowed space, with on-the-fly logistics. | | | | | | Peter, In 2023, our team conducted our first domestic rescue in California. A 12-year-old girl. Trafficked. Drugged. Raped. Held for 45 days in a homeless encampment under a bridge. Our operators physically extracted her. What it takes to be that team is what most people never see. The training. The intelligence work. The willingness to walk into a homeless encampment under a bridge knowing exactly what you might find and what you might have to do to bring a child out alive. The capacity to stay steady when the place you are going to is the worst place a 12-year-old has ever been. And underneath all of it, faith. Our operators are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure before they ever set foot on a mission – because the work breaks anyone who walks into it without something stronger than their own will to fall back on. We are the hands and feet of Jesus Christ in the field, and we have been since the day this organization started. That is not a slogan. It is the load-bearing piece of how a team walks under that bridge and walks back out with a 12-year-old girl alive. Thanks to God and the work of our operators, she made it home. Her family will never be the same. Neither will our team. She was one of nine children we recovered in California that year. Each one is a blessing, but know this – the next child is already missing. This is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments. Today, I write to you as the Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity. We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Fast forward, and today we are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work most organizations cannot. In the last 90 days alone, our team has operated across three continents – efforts which entailed: ✅ Eight American families extracted from Mexico in February. ✅ 33 American families and 155 additional Americans assisted across Israel, Egypt, and Jordan in March. ✅ 100,000+ meals distributed to individuals in desperate need in Haiti. ✅ Three more young teenage children rescued from trafficking situations in Virginia and West Texas this January. The work goes back further. 64 evacuated from Ukraine during active combat in 2022. 58 Christians rescued from persecution across Asia-Pacific and granted asylum. For five years we have done all of this from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But the demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way. So we've just launched an intensive, nationwide capital campaign for the Heroes for Humanity National Training Center – a permanent home for the mission, right here in our home state of Texas. The Training Center is a permanent facility built around the three pillars of our mission – precision personnel rescues, humanitarian and medical aid, and evangelism. Standardized certification for every operator we put in the field. Medical and trauma training for austere and hostile environments. An OSINT and intelligence hub for ongoing mission planning. Peter, I went back and forth on if I should send you this or not. Not because I didn't know what to say, but because I knew how much it would hurt to say it. It’s difficult to admit that I can't do this alone. [**There's so much weighing on me right now, and finding the right words feels impossible. But I'm trusting these words will reach you the way they need to.**](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/Va2uVamZ8IJyUlaD-2jqBC2--B2tpBSYAaLxyZtaqglZ_fZv-UwlD2P2z1ysIe5CTkGJvPGizYoDKB2fxCnjXBCsE-21KfBPyKElHEdCeoSiMT6VwaktEzCLkdLgcWPbRwtGAdJfjXm1fH-V6-sZsuBzbBRA1A--cGsIMHu2HckC3msKqu5n8vKf4TUWfyzE9niuIrFDLcgIsMRzZlGksV560_Te2d_2xQM6PxeL876wfJJCCjKdhLyyv8t1lrL4T678VDIovtaYXLLpLEejXql-qJaQBnSvvAZs2OOeKCJlv65Uki9ydwzFjhFWC5Ou0RVjAghSQk4XU-T0SDJ-zRF16pEVK0256ncC_6E_oUdpeamgyvNOvVzoegngojgGR9LrNcy0i2kpK7GqTsitnCzNtNwIW6QbKife5E_HoIrQn1Cxojpv6B5ozjWx_RhT2AbsQ3kPB9GDJkndyvLZayJ4TkmuyZpHKh75Hv8uC8iw3gUV3pNvSQw-LXu-8RRePQZoEP2eeJIKHZ69o4K9I0G_vS4RnpOuPxvsiqstb3dFvkYtbvYcvjKy_csLqY3sXiJIOhw932pVTN57-8aI2I5EyibPGnE-yNjhJSniLq-XTmdJ7I7-CDV3TCOejudW4hfNppSdwyzrehi3sYSTEZOI80rKhhmYbiiKr1IOetPpghXu27uPqu_FroaCPNlmvldEPj4BRoksOeVEaHirP5MxxLIcrszAFozWznxj5JdBNd7m69PHS_7wdsQNRXQ0J_eOUNe9iXFiPaPqTYgRZe9zoVUn6S5-ybGsmHHvPObMxUwiBVemHlmJVWhNkiCT56zpVI4/M6TjeTeWGjMiX0DBG9Z0ZH1JpEUbimuF/21) It’s Congressman Brandon Gill. Working cows and driving tractors growing up made me who I am today. It taught me the value of hard work, the importance of keeping your word, and what it means to sacrifice for something bigger than yourself. Trust me, I know all the constant emails and texts can weigh on you. It wears on me too. Some days I wonder if it's worth it. But then I remember why I'm here. I didn't come to Washington because I love asking true patriots like you for money. I didn't run for Congress at 29 years old to become the youngest House Republican so I could spend my nights begging for donations. I came because my kids deserve to grow up in a better America than I grew up in — and right now, that's not guaranteed. Being a husband and a father are the two most important things in my life. Sometimes, when I'm holding my kids, I feel like I'm holding the whole world in my arms. They're everything to me. They're the wind in my sails when it comes to the mission I've committed my life and career to. And at the end of my life, I want to sit before the Father Almighty and declare that I did all I could to leave this great country better off than it was when I grew up. I refuse to look my kids in the eye someday and tell them I gave up when it mattered most. [**That's why I'm still here. That's why I keep sending these messages.**](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/MLvXTkW5cb0DmKVtQ6viJqQxsV5j9fKI7ZzJOphnGuV-s-eemkSC_Co48loleGx2FhJ5ZEunPSa9CPpPn-FsGA7vTiqW7hdyovBLcn2DhZItr9VSjn_YlFAZfW_SdfQUPDJ3qGTbj4Ybnrrkkclm0FMn1yKc6VCNyxUbovPwxp-nltZ5E2AjGld65zQF70SNB1zP-Z6tmlbfSl1IKzvICviih6LAPChxyx0j6sgIBx-dB7qWZnwbR6GK0jaeh_uLi-Wsr97dW1XQn636iZxsK1UqEqqxj-DhvrLReaUK1slBa7QNoJx2qMMHuObMwC4CLfC_xcwKZCDi-I4YFlS4JQzDRnwuoNSsV5mFdq9HXBLdDadOrLZjHdAyMI9iBp0bGoSiGLlyR3aYg1zCHT1SoQxOPDk0hGWwaRnKndOuejn0yrN7FsyPzpngnH83NGHU-eORpFpC_NLneTHRfkUYBgZcBprp-u3mH0qI8mrleWhJiLk_vZKIfnXWZm_1YIe23WFgpaB28p_JFx6tiBf37YBr984f2PyxHLDfe2r5T0-dt9glXu-9ugvqopVoXPYIBKKXVyRRORB13jKf9b-wlRN3DkEHYeN2ujj-Lz4lsL1Tkp-dXi1NVai_oWTuvw9PDzd4tw-QHHZlALmC0TGmPi71LYFVdnwg5Gp-rDYDVtohJf0tm1kiltUji9aRwns-LWHaVCximG9GrEzPoH4HhX-LSDMXWYZj9sSe4Xj7fg0IjHVZlficFncVoQKn4TwFxfJWTjAzyBkybGdX9QHBddgL4Ohoj4Fq2wbWOKJJWszxtO9uMSEpbVrC-Uthe4lsqF-BQh0/WPV8jJ9V0vnhSfYET6cL224zLPKyIZeV/21) Because nothing — I repeat — nothing is more important to me than fighting off the vicious leftist attacks against the soul of our country. The left hates you. They hate your vote. They hate MAGA for putting America First. And they will do anything — lie, cheat, steal, destroy — to ensure your children inherit a country you won't even recognize. Peter, today I'll make the same promise to you that I've made to myself, to my wife, and to my children: As long as I live, I will continue to FIGHT to preserve the soul of our country. No force on Earth will push me to abandon my mission and calling. Not the attacks. Not the exhaustion. Not the constant pressure to give up and go home. clean_body: | | | | Peter, I went back and forth on if I should send you this or not. Not because I didn't know what to say, but because I knew how much it would hurt to say it. It’s difficult to admit that I can't do this alone. It’s Congressman Brandon Gill. Working cows and driving tractors growing up made me who I am today. It taught me the value of hard work, the importance of keeping your word, and what it means to sacrifice for something bigger than yourself. Trust me, I know all the constant emails and texts can weigh on you. It wears on me too. Some days I wonder if it's worth it. But then I remember why I'm here. I didn't come to Washington because I love asking true patriots like you for money. I didn't run for Congress at 29 years old to become the youngest House Republican so I could spend my nights begging for donations. I came because my kids deserve to grow up in a better America than I grew up in — and right now, that's not guaranteed. Being a husband and a father are the two most important things in my life. Sometimes, when I'm holding my kids, I feel like I'm holding the whole world in my arms. They're everything to me. They're the wind in my sails when it comes to the mission I've committed my life and career to. And at the end of my life, I want to sit before the Father Almighty and declare that I did all I could to leave this great country better off than it was when I grew up. I refuse to look my kids in the eye someday and tell them I gave up when it mattered most. Because nothing — I repeat — nothing is more important to me than fighting off the vicious leftist attacks against the soul of our country. The left hates you. They hate your vote. They hate MAGA for putting America First. And they will do anything — lie, cheat, steal, destroy — to ensure your children inherit a country you won't even recognize. Peter, today I'll make the same promise to you that I've made to myself, to my wife, and to my children: As long as I live, I will continue to FIGHT to preserve the soul of our country. No force on Earth will push me to abandon my mission and calling. Not the attacks. Not the exhaustion. Not the constant pressure to give up and go home. Believe me, I'm not someone who finds it easy to ask for support. Texting and emailing you like this is the last thing I thought I'd have to do when I ran for Congress. But the country we love is on the brink of destruction, and God has put it on my heart to fight with all that I have — even when that means swallowing my pride and asking for help. This is more than a polite request. This is now a final plea for your support. Sincerely, Congressman Brandon Gill (R) TX-26 | | | Paid for by Brandon Gill for Texas | | PO BOX 827 Arlington, VA 22216 |

My re-election campaign is in full swing and I would be so grateful to have you on my team.

After Graham Platner accused Susan Collins of sending him to war, Collins responded that he enlisted after the Iraq War had already begun and later worked for Blackwater. The exchange raised questions about Iraq War politics, military service, Iran, Democratic support for past wars and whether Platner's argument ignores his own decisions. The focus shifted to children shooting children, local officials staying silent, Somali community concerns and the need for a direct conversation in Lewiston.

name: Sheriff Joe Arpaio
subject: Help Free Two Innocent Officers Before It's Too Late
body:
Patriot,
This is a disgrace...and every American who believes in law and order should be furious.
Two police officers—Josh Taylor and Brandon Dingman—are currently serving prison sentences for doing exactly what they were trained and ordered to do: respond to a dangerous call, use non-lethal force, and protecting their community.
Let me tell you what really happened, because the media and the District Attorney certainly won't.
On the night of July 4th, 2019, Officer Josh Taylor responded to a domestic disturbance call in Wilson, Oklahoma. When he arrived, he encountered Jared Lakey: a large, fully grown man walking naked down the street wearing nothing but socks.
Josh immediately recognized this situation for what it was: dangerous and unpredictable. Whether it was drugs, mental illness, or something else—this wasn't a man in his right mind. And Josh knew he couldn't handle it alone. He called for backup.
[Donate to Their Defense](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=f4681514eb9f4b1284030e21dba1604d&_e=WlLSNi96UZClHneBX3VMLcSV8ENTtlvbhlkVlNDG5KFfDUQ_bkUzhsAvBaZLFvktXSgH00fUotFJNCXsd0xLV9Prw7YysdYbTrZSBARwP7vTJm_FPGjs88Nwy0G0cPaxyCNbTNqgl1WKP4EOM8mfHjWbUsHRQstP8l83-HYfno1pywq1l7QVTVt3B18JMgX_uEOBTmHIeR2Q4NrHSoUer5qxN9hjV1FwuALJ18EsgzxZUprG0YBLkzhrhjKjRsUZXS1VDuWtCWXrgZli4j9Itf9x0wQpLGTnQbR4VJdMIjefsQusoSdMikZnjIZG40MAiasUWzXLmjxLS_S19OTdvo8ndRv9G1wIbXu81O8IIv_Brrag7o7axPiewfIHaflc4aRUfdZoQQ2jDpr8yknhwUTPFQlkkgc-1eWTzGdYNq4O5cZSk7aIvgj-PnB9Max5)
Officer Josh Taylor
Officer Brandon Dingman
Officer Brandon Dingman arrived on scene, and the two officers tried to do what they were trained to do: safely and professionally bring Mr. Lakey into custody.
But Lakey was 350 pounds, combative, and resisting arrest. When verbal commands didn't work and physical restraint proved impossible, they turned to their department-issued, non-lethal tasers.
They deployed them multiple times, but Lakey kept tearing the barbs out. He was clearly not being fully affected by the tasers—and even after repeated attempts, the officers were unable to subdue him.
Eventually, Josh and Brandon were able to get his arms and cuffed him. They immediately called for medical assistance. An ambulance arrived. Lakey was taken to the hospital.
At that point, the officers had done everything they could—and everything right.
But tragically, Jared Lakey passed away two days later. The autopsy was inconclusive. He had an enlarged heart and lung issues. Drug screenings were unreliable due to the fluids pumped into his system at the hospital. There was no determined cause of death.
Even so, the department launched an internal review. Then the City Council reviewed the case too.
Both cleared the officers. That's two separate investigations concluding Josh and Brandon followed procedure.
Case closed, right?
Wrong.
A full year later, a politically motivated District Attorney, smelling an opportunity, dragged the case back up and charged these officers with second-degree murder.
Let that sink in: second-degree murder. He ignored the internal findings. He ignored the medical uncertainty. He ignored the fact that these officers never even laid a hand on Lakey's neck or airway.
They followed their training, used the gear they were issued, and even called for medical help.
But none of that mattered to a DA looking to make headlines.
Now, these two good cops, family men, community protectors, are sitting behind bars.
The National Center for Police Defense is fighting to overturn this injustice. We're supporting their legal appeals, helping their families, and backing efforts to remove the biased District Attorney who never should have touched this case in the first place.
But appeals are costly. And the longer this drags on, the longer Josh and Brandon sit in prison...separated from their families, their children, their lives.
That's why I'm writing you today. We need your help.
[Yes — I'll Donate Today](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=f4681514eb9f4b1284030e21dba1604d&_e=WlLSNi96UZClHneBX3VMLcSV8ENTtlvbhlkVlNDG5KFfDUQ_bkUzhsAvBaZLFvktXSgH00fUotFJNCXsd0xLV9Prw7YysdYbTrZSBARwP7vKIa6gUzm1lmu4DwrXnMYeeu1ydG3Qnx8mjbBlOtlCXdMM5KERBhq6c3Ln3DOH_cSZlFqZB8CkXPHX0hWp7lG17AJZ1vDZWNkpFO0pc7cCTxQwCk_fidXCCKWY9pDYG8sAyNQu_BRsBpeVo_1-KMNPcA07U2Jn_AU6bOwP6PtWKUCsXasSj1ysM0Xdcg83WUzSedGiwU2ut2Pf8f8GYoZJNF_94NY88pQ5OEPiDZK-tNGbY3vmViluhnGcrgX0CCQ2pK8sysfP-etz-Mw8zqAJmNNicw63N73bzANWjzCn7a3_Yok4CMz7g3amUKvlo443yJp6dyNup-sP3tt3v1uz)
We need to raise funds to fuel the legal defense and appeal process. These officers deserve their freedom. They deserve a fair hearing. And they deserve to come home.
We cannot let this go unanswered. If we don't stand up now, more and more police officers will suffer the same fate: thrown to the wolves by political activists in prosecutor's clothing.
Josh and Brandon were railroaded, plain and simple. And now we need to right this wrong.
Will you step up today and donate to support their appeals?
## Stand With Josh & Brandon
Every dollar goes directly to their legal defense and appeals. Help bring them home.
[Click Here to Donate](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=f4681514eb9f4b1284030e21dba1604d&_e=WlLSNi96UZClHneBX3VMLcSV8ENTtlvbhlkVlNDG5KFfDUQ_bkUzhsAvBaZLFvktXSgH00fUotFJNCXsd0xLV9Prw7YysdYbTrZSBARwP7s9LMS_lm7FfoiS_fzMzVSabSeCQkAU_vex9kPaM1Cc4hWCabu5oT7zZuYJFvtCz7PJ59OjdWBpin_nO0G-gEH_58OIF-dsRgeqrRyMwHM5n3NAn2wc8c9-Cm3r7WDwgZbEF6GCmCG73CK2YSGcAbo8XoWYua_jrEpkKNFCchW8O3giu4Nm53fEwsxkRs9_OTVaPrO4HDYXKH065QhyWMfDsu_rF1R3JtUC4xhBgQGsLfASQLBSyqK1Mr-DISn264WpQ9pIvP2ll5Gt0T0drIzxu-nHQmvIhyG14sUGBdCZ5qqseJa638IAlAfnR6Hp3L2Z1riMQ2g-sepQyxn9aK65)
Your generous gift goes to defending these officers and restoring justice. No family should have to go through this. No officer should be imprisoned for doing his job.
Let's send a message: we still back the badge—and we won't let politics destroy the lives of our heroes.
For justice,
Sheriff Joe Arpaio (ret.)
National Center for Police Defense | Defenders for Justice

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Patti Fox’s daughter was building a life. A driver ran a stop sign.](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
Something woke Patti Fox at midnight.
She looked at her phone screen and saw missed calls going back to 10:15 p.m. A friend of Carissa’s had called over and over from Chicago. He’d been tracking her on a location app and saw that she’d been moved to a hospital.
Fox started calling hospitals in Aurora. Getting anyone to tell her anything was its own fight. Carissa didn’t have her driver’s license on her that night and had been checked in as a Jane Doe. When Fox finally located her at HCA Health One, the message from staff was short.
“They said, ‘get here,’” Fox told RMV.

**[Tina Peters asks Colorado Supreme Court to overturn convictions after juror wondered if she was “targeted”](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **A juror's phone lines were cut mid-trial — no one investigated:** During Tina Peters' trial, a juror's business lines were cut, costing $4,000 to restore. She spent 10 days wondering if she was "targeted" before voting to convict — and neither the court nor attorneys were told until after the verdict.
* **The judge denied a hearing in hours; appeals court agreed:** Peters' attorneys filed for a post-trial hearing the morning of September 20, 2024 — denied that same afternoon — and the Court of Appeals upheld the ruling this spring without ever quoting the juror's recorded statements about feeling targeted.
* **Peters is now asking the Colorado Supreme Court to overturn her convictions:** Citing Remmer v. United States (1954) — which established unauthorized juror contact requires a hearing — Peters argues lower courts used Rule 606(b) as an absolute wall when it explicitly allows investigation into outside influence.

**[“The Constitution reigns supreme”: A warning about sanctuary states and political power](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY MICHAEL J BADAGLIACCO "MJB", [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Sanctuary states are using noncitizens to gain congressional seats:** Montrose Mayor Michael Badagliacco argues that states like Colorado and California are shielding noncitizens to inflate census counts — and since the Constitution counts all persons for apportionment, noncitizens who can't vote are nonetheless shaping congressional districts and Electoral College strength.
* **The math is stark:** According to the Center for Immigration Studies, immigrants will redistribute 22 House seats in the 2030 apportionment — California gaining nine, Colorado projected to lose one — transferring political power from citizen-heavy states to high-noncitizen jurisdictions.
* **The legal authority to fix it already exists:** Badagliacco argues the Supremacy Clause makes federal immigration law supreme over sanctuary policies, points to DOJ lawsuits already challenging them, and calls for voter ID confirming citizenship — noting France, Germany, and Mexico all exclude noncitizens from national voting.

The judge denied a hearing in hours; appeals court agreed: Peters' attorneys filed for a post-trial hearing the morning of September 20, 2024 — denied that same afternoon — and the Court of Appeals upheld the ruling this spring without ever quoting the juror's recorded statements about feeling targeted. Peters is now asking the Colorado Supreme Court to overturn her convictions: Citing Remmer v. United States (1954) — which established unauthorized juror contact requires a hearing — Peters argues lower courts used Rule 606(b) as an absolute wall when it explicitly allows investigation into outside influence. | The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado.
