Peter**, it’s happening: Alligator Alcatraz is shutting down.** For the past 43 weeks, the Workers Circle and our allies have been holding freedom vigils outside this detention facility in the Florida Everglades, bearing witness, building relationships, and refusing to let the people inside be forgotten. The vigils will continue until no one is detained in that reprehensible facility. And we are not standing idly by. In a new initiative, the Workers Circle and Sanctuary of the South are working together to identify as many people as possible at Alligator Alcatraz in need of legal consultation and provide that to them free of charge. **And even if the people are scattered to another detention center before we can get them help, our support will follow them. We need to reach as many as possible before they disappear into the system all over again.** [**We’ll put it bluntly: We need to raise $300,000 as fast as possible. Our team is working day and night to secure these funds so that we can get detainees the support that they deserve. At this critical moment, will you split a contribution between United for Democracy and the Workers Circle of an amount that feels meaningful to you?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvd8hCserj-XmGYLB0-0IMXA0QZWXJsPvmDPwpEJV8sDXUgViVxxWwhoWM0nYmeiyJnGLXMdpDlNX4bCNQM-bMIcyrxwT4SyUwPj164g26-6AW0b47wjeXn3c3EsZMWHxpJ33T_i4P24p6d3e7AvqZu19rea5ngLLYiCyGS9yXHdQDrFS7DKjfyvelcyNOq_6C7DHjX3KKZfQIyr6qkbGldXLZqgt6I7-C27jdb9D-Mi_vjYvbX5zVnnMaZT5UzmsT6kGJueTLl8MTn45LNumI2LQPnw8h_Y9eTClj9wcbeQluqwGdo9p_rEfNFXrtdO4gwy3zjJQIUvBHPasC9yS1W/4r0/Rkco6mt8RHOG_SLlIPSmmg/h0/h001.upZRvfEoX2ml_ZtuQkj6vb-QDDS6yohCW4QPm9Bsdb8) **** [DONATE](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvd8hCserj-XmGYLB0-0IMXA0QZWXJsPvmDPwpEJV8sDXUgViVxxWwhoWM0nYmeiyJnGLXMdpDlNX4bCNQM-bMIhWdoi20ES5PvfqYg96j-_Yba_lwqZd7zK83QO7WwONR7xpPU3wsykOlM3xxchJ5e3QuBY2I3LahuEHxiDyCtgSMUea6b1pa3LWrJsmS5jqY1iMz44aeXvw8mYLFi28Fa8uNlgOmArkvkX0kwVnn7vr4TQHrA9X_Puja7Jlw81NwIGT0EDdY5daFG2PBY61I35ALBb_KD4emkfEsk4O7XWmRdrRI087lzhzlTLQ_TGhBzVC2KmrZcSjuuq1P-_e8o/4r0/Rkco6mt8RHOG_SLlIPSmmg/h1/h001.7H_p0Gvjr8-k3Kk5_wt1ZEm_zQZS2QPE81aKZOiw6D4) Through our vigil work at Alligator Alcatraz, we've already connected directly with about 50 people and their families who have no legal representation and no money. **Many of them likely have viable habeas or bond cases – legal arguments that could get them freed.** **But they'll never know that if no attorney ever looks at their file.** Of the roughly 1,500 people who have been detained at Alligator Alcatraz, the vast majority are navigating this system without counsel. Most cannot afford counsel and thus languish for months without due process. We aim to change that. Participating immigration attorneys will provide low bono (greatly reduced) legal rates, to provide universal consultations for all in need and assess cases for viability, with a focus on securing release. The money being raised right now will cover attorney’s fees and costs, filing fees, and bond payments, as well as the infrastructure to intake, screen, triage, and represent as many of these people as possible before Alligator Alcatraz closes and to allow legal support to follow them wherever they go from there. This is what the vigils were for, so that we could build the trust and relationships that make something like this possible. Over these past 43 weeks, we have built a community with the activists, families, and even some of the detainees who have suffered under the actions of this administration. Peter, some of the people we've met have already been scammed. They handed over thousands of dollars to attorneys who never filed a motion, or who let their cases sit. They've been failed, exploited, and abused at every turn. All too often, when this administration takes an action that is cruel and meant to harm our neighbors, we have little to no recourse to stop them. **This is one of the few times where we can make a direct impact in the lives of people targeted by Donald Trump, and we cannot let it pass.** And this is only the beginning. We plan to grow the pilot program at Alligator Alcatraz to encompass other detention centers, and when Alligator Alcatraz finally closes its doors, we will immediately funnel these resources to other individuals suffering in detention, prioritizing detention centers such as Alligator Alcatraz that are able to operate inhumanely and detain individuals without due process largely because they have been able to operate in the dark, without insight or oversight. This collaboration changes that, and we will continue to mobilize to address the current detention crises wherever it remains. **As quickly as we are moving to get legal help to the people detained at Alligator Alcatraz, this administration is moving even faster to scatter them in other detention facilities around the country, and their families, advocates, and attorneys will have to start tracing all over again.** [**Your donation – $18, $36, $72, or even more – truly, whatever you can give – directly funds accessing legal representation for people who have none. clean_body: | | Peter, it’s happening: Alligator Alcatraz is shutting down. For the past 43 weeks, the Workers Circle and our allies have been holding freedom vigils outside this detention facility in the Florida Everglades, bearing witness, building relationships, and refusing to let the people inside be forgotten. The vigils will continue until no one is detained in that reprehensible facility. And we are not standing idly by. In a new initiative, the Workers Circle and Sanctuary of the South are working together to identify as many people as possible at Alligator Alcatraz in need of legal consultation and provide that to them free of charge. And even if the people are scattered to another detention center before we can get them help, our support will follow them. We need to reach as many as possible before they disappear into the system all over again. ** Through our vigil work at Alligator Alcatraz, we've already connected directly with about 50 people and their families who have no legal representation and no money. Many of them likely have viable habeas or bond cases – legal arguments that could get them freed. But they'll never know that if no attorney ever looks at their file. Of the roughly 1,500 people who have been detained at Alligator Alcatraz, the vast majority are navigating this system without counsel. Most cannot afford counsel and thus languish for months without due process. We aim to change that. Participating immigration attorneys will provide low bono (greatly reduced) legal rates, to provide universal consultations for all in need and assess cases for viability, with a focus on securing release. The money being raised right now will cover attorney’s fees and costs, filing fees, and bond payments, as well as the infrastructure to intake, screen, triage, and represent as many of these people as possible before Alligator Alcatraz closes and to allow legal support to follow them wherever they go from there. This is what the vigils were for, so that we could build the trust and relationships that make something like this possible. Over these past 43 weeks, we have built a community with the activists, families, and even some of the detainees who have suffered under the actions of this administration. Peter, some of the people we've met have already been scammed. They handed over thousands of dollars to attorneys who never filed a motion, or who let their cases sit. They've been failed, exploited, and abused at every turn. All too often, when this administration takes an action that is cruel and meant to harm our neighbors, we have little to no recourse to stop them. This is one of the few times where we can make a direct impact in the lives of people targeted by Donald Trump, and we cannot let it pass. And this is only the beginning. We plan to grow the pilot program at Alligator Alcatraz to encompass other detention centers, and when Alligator Alcatraz finally closes its doors, we will immediately funnel these resources to other individuals suffering in detention, prioritizing detention centers such as Alligator Alcatraz that are able to operate inhumanely and detain individuals without due process largely because they have been able to operate in the dark, without insight or oversight. This collaboration changes that, and we will continue to mobilize to address the current detention crises wherever it remains. As quickly as we are moving to get legal help to the people detained at Alligator Alcatraz, this administration is moving even faster to scatter them in other detention facilities around the country, and their families, advocates, and attorneys will have to start tracing all over again.** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately, split evenly between | | | | | | | | | | Your support has gotten us this far. subject: The most corrupt politician in American history
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
I don’t want to hear another word about my community come out of Trump’s mouth when he should be behind bars right now.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2243%2E791427%2EdjqQUK)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may26.WVAuyg&refcode=em260528-3-180&t=2&akid=2243%2E791427%2EdjqQUK)
Friend, Trump wants to paint me and people from my community as “crooked” because he is currently the most corrupt politician in American history, and voters of all parties are starting to notice.
Let’s not forget, Trump’s second term began with a massive cryptocurrency “rug pull” scam that netted his family at least $1 billion, and he has continued to build his fortune more than any other President to ever take office.
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may26.WVAuyg&refcode=em260528-3-180&t=3&akid=2243%2E791427%2EdjqQUK)
Under Trump’s rule, fraudsters, scammers, and grifters of all kinds have received special treatment, especially if they have donated to his campaigns. He’s pardoned dozens of financial criminals who have been responsible for ripping off innocent people and were rightly facing the consequences.
Some of those pardons have even wiped out billions that were to be spent on victim repayment and taxpayer recovery for things like Medicare fraud.
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may26.WVAuyg&refcode=em260528-3-180&t=4&akid=2243%2E791427%2EdjqQUK)
And now Trump has once again topped himself with his level of corruption and self-dealing, suing the federal government and having his own Justice Department award him a $1.8 billion slush fund, which he intends to use to pay off the violent rioters who stormed our Capitol on January 6th, 2021.
I could go on; really — it would take me all day to lay out all of the corruption and pay-to-play that is happening inside this White House and across the administration, as some articles have attempted to do:
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/5893?t=5&akid=2243%2E791427%2EdjqQUK)
The bottom line is that Trump has turned the entire government into a mechanism to enrich himself, reward his allies, and ruthlessly punish his opponents, me included. And that’s not even taking into account his past attempts to steal an election, his various impeachable offenses, his disregard for civil rights, his war crimes, and the 34 felony counts against him.
**I don’t want to hear another word about my community come out of Trump’s mouth when he should be behind bars right now.**
If you are sick and tired of being preached to about who is “crooked” by the most crooked man in America, I’m asking you to join me as we continue to build momentum towards the midterm elections this November, when we can win a majority that will investigate Trump and hold him responsible.
[**Chip in your first donation to my campaign and help me take on any and all of Trump’s attacks as we work to defeat his corrupt MAGA movement. Your donation helps us build towards victory every single day, no matter the amount you can afford to give.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-may26.WVAuyg&refcode=em260528-3-180&t=6&akid=2243%2E791427%2EdjqQUK)

name: Roy Cooper
subject: They can't scare me into backing down.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by In This Together PAC
body:
I am ready for the fight.
_Hi there, it's Governor Andy Beshear. I'm sharing this message from my good friend, Governor Roy Cooper who is running for US Senate in North Carolina. Please listen to what he has to say and consider getting involved in this race to elect a good man in an important seat:_ Stop the chaos.

Peter, this is what elected leaders must do in the face of an administration that is intent on destroying our democracy for their own gain.

I have spent my career working for North Carolinians. Advocating for more resources for students in public schools and better pay for teachers. Building a clean energy economy to bring good-paying jobs to our communities while protecting this planet. Defending the right to cast a ballot and participate in our democracy. Fighting for Medicaid Expansion and winning it for the people. **I stand ready to do all this and more to deliver for the American people as the next Democratic Senator from North Carolina.**

_Far-right Republicans don't tend to like that about me—and they don't want me bringing this fight to Washington._

They're preparing to spend untold sums trying to take me down.

But I know how to win here. **And I will not back down.**

_Because I have you on my side._

-- ORIGINAL MESSAGE FROM MAY 27 --
Friends,
For nearly 25 years, I represented our nation around the world. During my time as USCIS’s Director of International Operations, I helped coordinate responses to a wide variety of national emergencies, and I’m proud of my time spent working to keep Americans safe. I’ll take the same commitment to service to Congress, but I need your help to get there.
We need to raise $10,000 by the end of the month to keep our organizing efforts on track — can you please donate any amount today?
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/trina-swanson-may-email?&amount=25&refcode=20260528]
One of the most important things I learned during my time in this public service is how fragile democracies can become. All it takes is one determined authoritarian leader willing to tear down the pillars of representative government, and unfortunately what we’re seeing here at home reminds me of the type of democratic erosion I’ve seen in other nations.
The MAGA movement has consolidated power in the hands of a president who is determined to tilt the scales of our democracy in his favor. Trump has coordinated with the Supreme Court to allow Republican states to disenfranchise voters for political gain, and he’s threatened to use federal law enforcement officers to disrupt elections across the nation. Even though polls show that Trump’s approval rating continues to fall, Democrats face a tough battle to retake the House due to Republican gerrymandering and voter suppression efforts.
Winning in districts like ours is critical to flipping the House blue and delivering results for central and northern Minnesota. My roots have always been here in Minnesota — I understand what our communities need, and how to get results. That’s why I won the DFL nomination and our people-powered campaign is getting ready to compete in every corner of this huge district.

name: Senate Majority Alert
subject: Let’s talk about Texas
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
The truth is the path to a Democratic Senate majority runs through two states: Texas and New Hampshire.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=6889%2E582294%2EEAiLm1)
Team,
On Tuesday Ken Paxton officially became the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate in Texas.
Paxton is scandal-plagued and the worst kind of corrupt politician: indicted then impeached _by members of his own party_ over allegations he abused his office for personal gain.

body:

| | |
# Every American Should _Unlock_ Their IRA/401k In 2026
---
|
---
| | Most Americans have no idea their Retirement Plan is _locked down_.
---
---
Let’s say you’re at a restaurant -- you can order anything you want, as long as it’s on the menu. But what if you found out you have a fish allergy, and you’re at a seafood restaurant? Because if you’ve had an employer 401(k), then you remember seeing the options: You can invest in anything you want, as long as it’s on the menu. Same thing with many IRA plans.
---
**But what happens if**** _everything on the menu_****can make you sick?** That’s what many Americans are facing right now. Because whether you order the S&P Index Fund, the 60/40 Stocks and Bonds mix, or any other combination on the menu... All the ingredients come from the same kitchen -- the stock market. **And you already know the stock market has made people**** _sick_****.****** The ups and downs can be nauseating. Now that’s _not_ a problem if you’re a few decades away from retirement, because you can ride out the storm, and things could likely turn in your favor. **But when you’re already retired, or about to retire, then the game changes.** Because it’s not about growing your assets anymore, it’s about _preserving_ your assets, right? That means if you have $1 million saved for retirement... Then you expect that million to pay for your travel, gifts, visits to family and grandkids... For the rest of your life. Literally! And that’s a great plan.
---
---
---
So how do you tackle the problem? You could hope the stock market rockets up again, and grows your retirement... **[Or you could look at assets that help defend against inflation.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** Except the problem is, many IRAs and 401(k)s can be _locked out_ of inflation-defending assets. But it doesn’t have to be that way. Because right now, **_thousands of Americans_** have figured out how to **_UNLOCK_** their IRA/401(k) so they can diversify a portion of their retirement savings into assets that help defend against inflation.
---
[**That’s why we put together this free guide.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) It’s a brief, to-the-point handbook that shows you:
---
* **The IRS Rule That Lets You Access Locked Retirement Funds**
* **Who _Really_ Controls Your Retirement Savings**
* **How To Transition To An Unlocked IRA**

---
| | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
And it’s completely free to get a copy. So what you do with your retirement savings is your business, but at the very least, you should be educated about your options. But of course, the choice is yours.
---
[**GET YOUR FREE GUIDE THAT UNLOCKS YOUR IRA/401(k)**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---

| | Peter, I released my annual financial disclosure form, and it only took me 5 minutes – because I don’t own any stocks.

And that’s exactly what Republicans love attacking me for: not being rich.

They can attack me all they want, but I have _no_ shame. Unlike them, I haven’t abused my office to get rich off stock trading.

When I ran for Congress, I drove for Uber and took on credit card debt just to get by. And after my swearing in, I got denied from apartments in D.C. because of my credit.

So it’s funny when I get called out for experiencing the struggles that working class Americans experience everyday – because shouldn’t we have more leaders who know what it’s like? I think if we did, Congress would work a lot better than it does now.

I’m proud to represent us, and I’m committed to fighting for all of us. But it wasn’t easy for someone like me to get to Congress, so I need your support to stay here. # [What I learned on the debate stage](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=199633909&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk5NjMzOTA5LCJpYXQiOjE3ODAwMDc1MzMsImV4cCI6MTc4MjU5OTUzMywiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.uyLXDswoosmUrLOVjoZipl0Nij4C8FrqhckozzX9bpw)
### Michiganders deserve a workhorse, not a showhorse
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| May 28
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvaGFsZXlmb3JtaS9wL3doYXQtaS1sZWFybmVkLW9uLXRoZS1kZWJhdGUtc3RhZ2U_.kuM0Nt3wH6uZp91hPU_suXwcWW89qSCMtio3mmVQAzI?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)

---

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/535ce468-acb9-457b-a8e5-c83f2a6e4793?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I got off the debate stage about a few hours ago, and I wanted to write to you while it's still fresh.
Here is what I want you to know: **[The next Democratic senator from Michigan's first job is to beat Mike Rogers in November.](https://substack.com/redirect/27f67c85-d787-4699-bb76-8bb1d80153d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
I want to be honest with you about that, because the math is clear. Michigan is key in deciding whether the Senate is run by people who give a damn about working families - or by people who are going to rubber-stamp everything Donald Trump sends them.
There are no points for _almost_ winning. There are no participation trophies in this battleground race. Democrats either win Michigan or we hand the Senate to MAGA Republicans.
I am running because I am the candidate who can win this race. And I am not just saying that - the polls are too.
I'm the Democrat who beats Mike Rogers in head-to-head polling. I'm the Democrat leading the entire primary field with Independents - the voters who actually decide Michigan elections each November. Even Republicans have called me their "toughest general election opponent."
That is not bragging. That is the November math I'm talking about.
But here is the part that matters more: Michigan does not need a senator who is trying to go viral. Michigan needs a senator who gets sh*t done.
Michigan deserves a workhorse, not a showhorse.
**[That's the choice: you can vote for virality or you can vote to win.](https://substack.com/redirect/27f67c85-d787-4699-bb76-8bb1d80153d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
I win.
Here's my record: I helped save 200,000 Michigan auto jobs as Chief of Staff on President Obama's Auto Rescue. I helped write and pass the CHIPS and Science Act, which is bringing semiconductor manufacturing back to American soil, and to Michigan. I was named the most effective Michigan Democrat in Congress because I show up, I do the work, and I get bills across the finish line.
**I am not the only legislator running for this seat. But I am the most effective one.**
And here is the part I want to say plainly, because a lot of public servants have forgotten the _serve_ part of the job description: I am not in this to get rich. Or to be famous.
**I 'm not a millionaire and I did not go to Congress to set myself up. **I went to Washington to deliver for Michigan's working families - and now I'm asking you to send me to the Senate to keep doing that work. That is the only reason I am running. There is no other agenda. This is not a branding opportunity. I love Michigan and I will fight like hell for my home.
I will fight to lower the cost of prescription drugs, defend Medicare and Medicaid, and protect the science-based care our families and our seniors depend on. I will fight to bring down housing costs and rebuild the path to homeownership that used to be a basic part of the middle class. I will fight to invest in Michigan manufacturing. I will fight to make sure clean drinking water is treated as a right, not a privilege. I will fight for federal investment in the communities that have been waiting for far too long.
That is the work. That is the job. That's what I am running to do.
Today on that stage, I felt more sure than ever that the Michiganders I love deserve a true fighter in the Senate. And I'd be honored to have you with me.
**[Friends, if you're in a position to chip in before our end-of-month deadline, I'd be grateful. This is a grassroots campaign, so every dollar helps keep Michigan blue.](https://substack.com/redirect/27f67c85-d787-4699-bb76-8bb1d80153d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
But I want you to know - with or without your financial support - I am in this fight for you.
And I'm more fired up than ever.
With grit,
Haley
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/27f67c85-d787-4699-bb76-8bb1d80153d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Never give up on our country.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
I still believe in the United States of America, and there’s no chance in hell that somebody like Trump is going to stop me from serving the people of this nation.
#

friend,
It’s hard to believe what happened over the last several months.
It didn’t stop when Trump called for me to be hanged. It didn’t stop when Pete Hegseth threatened me with a court-martial, either. It didn’t stop when the Department of Justice tried and failed to indict me, or when Hegseth censured me and tried to demote me in rank.
They came after the rank I earned through 25 years of military service — all for saying things the president didn’t like to hear. Even now, even after a federal court ruled in my favor, they still haven’t stopped.
It would be easy to see all that and feel like this isn’t the country you grew up in. That Trump’s changed things too much, and there’s no coming back.
But friend, I really hope you haven’t given up. I certainly haven’t.
This country has given me too much, and I’ll never be able to repay that debt. I still believe in the United States of America, and there’s no chance in hell that somebody like Trump is going to stop me from serving the people of this nation. None.
Trump and Hegseth thought all of that would shut me up. They could not have been more wrong.
And if you’re willing to join me as we gear up for the most important midterm election of our lives, please:

body:
Susan Collins voted to send American Troops to both Afghanistan and Iraq. She voted repeatedly to continue funding those wars, and voted consistently to keep American Troops fighting them.
#
This is the exact kind of drivel we’ve come to expect from politicians like Susan Collins:
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-may26.in4ulI&refcode=em260528-1-120&t=1&akid=35178%2E3013755%2Egw1jiF)
Susan Collins voted to send American Troops to both Afghanistan and Iraq. She voted repeatedly to continue funding those wars, and voted consistently to keep fighting them. It took her more than 20 years to finally vote to repeal the Iraq Authorization for Use of Military Force.
And after all that, she didn’t learn shit. For 60 days, she let Trump off the leash in Iran. For 60 days, she had a duty to exercise her authority as a Senator and prevent Trump from dragging the United States into a war of choice. For 60 days, she abdicated that duty.
People like Graham Platner signed up to serve because they believe in duty. They trusted politicians like Susan Collins. They answered the call when our country asked them to. 7000 of them never came back, and 30,000 killed themselves after they came home.
Susan Collins thinks signing up to serve in uniform was their failure, not hers. But when you look at the problems we face today, don’t look at Veterans. Look straight back at her, and all of her votes over her 29 years in the Senate.
VoteVets is going to work night and day to defeat her. Watching her lose her seat this November isn’t going to undo all the harm she’s caused, but it’s for damn sure a good start.

clean_body: Every flag supports Veterans for Congress and helps honor the country they fought for. | Fellow American, This Independence Day, House Republicans are launching a nationwide mission to place 50,000 American flags into the hands of proud patriots across the country. But this effort is about far more than flags. Every single flag claimed helps support Veterans for Congress, brave Americans who served this nation in uniform and are now stepping forward once again to defend it in Washington. From small towns to major cities, we want the Stars and Stripes flying proudly in every corner of America before July 4th arrives. And with America 's 250th birthday right around the corner, this mission carries even greater meaning. These flags represent sacrifice. They represent freedom. They represent the people who built this country and the heroes who protected it. We 're running out of time to complete distribution before July 4th, and we're asking patriots like you to help us finish the mission strong. Please step up today, support Veterans for Congress, and claim your American flag before supplies run out. I want to tell you about something that keeps me going:
**_Believing in faith over fear._**
Someone handed me this hat at a recent interview, the last one they had. I put it on immediately. Because those three words say everything: **_faith over fear._**
It’s also how I’ve tried to govern: With grace under pressure. It’s what keeps me and my team going when Washington is coming for everything we’ve built together.
Hard times reveal character, and right now, basic values we inherited are being threatened. We have to make the choice to protect them -- and pass them on to our children, and our children's children.
**That’s the work._And it doesn’t stop._**

body:
Help me spend more time with voters
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260528-2856)
Peter,
This primary is heating up, and we need your help.
We set an ambitious end-of-month goal: $20,000 to help us reach voters across Wisconsin. The good news? We’re halfway there!
**But we still need your help: We need to raise $10,000 in the next three days to keep us on track.**
This campaign is on the road seven days a week, meeting voters where they are. Your grassroots donations help make sure I can spend more time talking to voters on the ground and less time asking for money on the phone.
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260528.Iy92rD&refcode=em20260528-2856&t=1&akid=2856%2E105371%2EkStqRm)
This week in Adams County I spoke with working people – the kind of folks who make Wisconsin an incredible place to live. We talked about the challenges of rural life when we’re still living with the Walker/Vos policy hangover. The difficulties when the government doesn’t provide support for our healthcare workers, and rural schools are crushing – these conversations are emotional, and they’re important.
I am a leader who is always going to put those conversations first, and that means that sometimes I’ll need more help from our community to make up fundraising gaps.
[**I’m asking you to contribute $10, $20, or more if you can so we can keep these conversations happening and showing everyone across the state what government looks like when it puts people first.**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260528.Iy92rD&refcode=em20260528-2856&t=2&akid=2856%2E105371%2EkStqRm)

Thanks y’all, and looking forward to seeing you on the road - I’ll be in Waushara tonight (Thursday), Stevens Point tomorrow (Friday), Woodruff tomorrow night, and Milwaukee on Saturday.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260528.Iy92rD&amount=5&refcode=em20260528-2856&t=22&akid=2856%2E105371%2EkStqRm)**
With gratitude,
Fran

| | If you’re looking for one of the most effective ways you can help our elections run smoothly, **we’re asking you to please consider being a poll worker in 2026. Sign up today to get started on the application process! ** Poll workers are the too-often-unsung heroes who keep polling places running — and keep the process fair and efficient — so everyone can cast their ballot and have it counted. And if there aren’t enough poll workers available, there can be real consequences. **A study found that poll worker shortages contributed to longer lines for voters, and that lines were longer at precincts serving more people of color.** In addition, look at these stories from around the Texas primary earlier this year: _“Nine polling locations close due to poll worker shortage in Hidalgo County” —ValleyCentral_ _“Poll worker shortage is forcing Montgomery County to combine more than a dozen voting precincts” —Houston Chronicle_ _“Election officials warn that Tarrant County may face challenges on Tuesday because of a shortage of election workers” —CBS News_ If someone doesn’t have time to wait in a long line before their shift starts, or if they can’t spare the gas money to drive to a more distant polling place, they might not be able to cast their ballot. And we need everyone to have equal access to the ballot to ensure free and fair elections. To help prevent these shortfalls, we’re mounting an aggressive effort with our partners to recruit more poll workers. [**We’re proud to team up with Power the Polls, a nonpartisan initiative which has driven over a million poll worker sign-ups and supported election administrators in thousands of precincts since its founding in 2020. Click here to learn more and sign up.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132268593/623949606/-603987198?refcode=emm_ffa_20260528_T1_PowerthePolls_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NmY0NDE3Ni1lOTVhLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=d6jxpvjXkFW_OwvbzPId-BGHwmfzRJW8xh7Z0CBpaIw=&emci=64f44176-e95a-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=66f44176-e95a-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=1037277) People who’ve gotten involved through Power the Polls have reported overwhelmingly positive takeaways. In a survey after the 2022 elections, 95% of poll workers they recruited said they had a satisfying experience. 88% said they’d be interested in serving again. name: Roy Cooper (via Cooper Victory Fund)
subject: I’m counting on you
body:
I’ve been able to win tough fights because folks like you believed in me. I need you to believe in me again.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1571%2E124072%2EGBY6z2)
| | | |
---
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/12369?t=8&akid=1571%2E124072%2EGBY6z2)
Peter, I love North Carolina with all my heart.
I’ve served as Attorney General and taken on the drug companies and big banks to return billions of dollars to North Carolina families. I’ve served as Governor and led the fight to expand Medicaid and protect our fundamental rights.
But before all that, I was young in Nash County, attending public schools and working summers on the farm. I didn’t anticipate getting the chance to serve the people of my home state for so many years – and to now be running for U.S. Senate.
**Throughout my life, I’ve been able to win tough fights because folks like you believed in me. I need you to believe in me again.**
**[We’ve set a goal to add another 25,000 General Election Founding Donors to our campaign so we can keep powering this movement to flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate – and I’m counting on you to be one of them. Will you chip in $5?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/12370?amount=5&t=9&akid=1571%2E124072%2EGBY6z2)**
| | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/12370?amount=5&t=10&akid=1571%2E124072%2EGBY6z2)
---
With experts saying that Senate control is at stake in this race, GOP super PACs are so far spending nearly $100 million on attack ads – more than anywhere else in the country – to defeat me in the fall.
**My only chance at fighting back against this surge in dark money is by building a historic grassroots team, full of hundreds of thousands of people like you.**
Peter, thousands of folks have chipped in to become General Election Founding Donors – and because of their support, we’ve been able to reach voters across the state and stay competitive in this race.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: It’s time to tax AI
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
There should be no "permanent underclass” because of AI

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2914%2E4032634%2EAykZNu)
---
Tech executives are warning that AI could lead to “a level of wealth concentration that will break society” and create a "permanent underclass." Those are their words. I refuse to accept that future. And stopping Big Tech from hoarding the benefits of AI will take all of us speaking up together. So I’ve just called on the government to tax AI and invest in people. [**Add your name if you agree: If AI is going to reshape our economy, we need to tax AI-driven wealth and invest in people — not just profits.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ai-tax/?source=EW_EMZ31M_AIT_ENG_20260528_F&t=8&akid=2914%2E4032634%2EAykZNu) | [**I WANT TO TAX AI**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ai-tax/?source=EW_EMZ31M_AIT_ENG_20260528_F&t=9&akid=2914%2E4032634%2EAykZNu)
---
AI holds tremendous promise. At the same time, Americans are rightly concerned that AI could further rig our economy.
But I also believe that the winnings from AI must benefit all Americans, rather than channeling them only to the wealthy few.
AI was trained on human creativity and intelligence. It was funded by federal research that taxpayers paid for. And it's powered by data centers built on American land, using our shared electric grid.
The American people deserve to share in that success. But right now, that's not happening.
This technology is creating dozens of tech billionaires while companies lay off workers in the name of AI. And AI data centers are jacking up electricity bills for nearby families — costs have skyrocketed by as much as 267% over the past five years.
Taxing AI will raise the money we need to deliver universal healthcare. So if thousands of workers get fired because of AI, those workers don't go bankrupt just from a doctor's visit.
And if AI transforms the future of work, then taxing AI will give us the resources to invest in things like free college and apprenticeship programs. And a jobs guarantee, so that all Americans can have good-paying work.
And how do we get there?
First, we close the loopholes. Right now our tax code gives corporations a break for investing in AI and penalizes them for hiring humans. That has to end.
Second, pass a wealth tax. Billionaire CEOs shouldn't pay lower tax rates than the workers they fire.
Third, tax AI data centers directly. Trillion-dollar companies can afford it — and a well-designed tax scales with their size. Meaning the larger the data center, the more it pays.
[**Do you want to tax AI and really invest in people? Then add your name today to show there’s strong demand for a plan like this.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ai-tax/?source=EW_EMZ31M_AIT_ENG_20260528_F&t=10&akid=2914%2E4032634%2EAykZNu)
[**ADD MY NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ai-tax/?source=EW_EMZ31M_AIT_ENG_20260528_F&t=11&akid=2914%2E4032634%2EAykZNu)
---
Thanks for being part of this,
Elizabeth

Republican Task Force Issue: 5/28/2026

Iran Ceasefire Outline Reached

U.S. and Iranian negotiators have [reached an outline agreement](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL0OnDAQhJ_GdEb2AoYrXKShu7Qp0WIvd6szP1qbQ3n76E6K0qedbzQafb_u0x058fb4iSt5KcsU9zgVOdfj4i3P_Fi__L0X3h5hAgNOm07DMG1pslX0MUS0oSJv-8EYC61tq6cP6ABsb_t-NnOk2y26xc1DbAZ3mxfjKvafKdPBAE3XNE1N_dINYDq0YIJxg2oNJpJSCx3nnDjgVjC_ll0C1WFfq-SfpRxZNT8UjArG67pqobOQ5A__JLukqGBcOcZEmjAXBSMLbvrMughG0siicxF-UdZCxy5FZ_yd9d-WEIan3s-SeCMdCDMtLKQjYdL_bCgYK_HxuDglzq5Xrfma-z4t_yH27eFPAAAA__8qEolA) to extend the ceasefire in the three-month U.S.-Israel war on Iran, according to Reuters and Axios. President Trump has not yet signed off on the framework, leaving the deal in limbo. The outline emerged even as both sides exchanged fresh strikes Thursday. Iran [reportedly targeted a U.S. base](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL1u7CAQRp8Gd1gw-O8WFLexlGLTprTGMPaiYLBg1vv60W6VOu13pE9H5-u23DDEkPZPPMgW3haf_cLlcZzPkOoa9uPNr8wh7W4BBYNUvYRpSXHRjbfeedSuIavHSSkNne6aux3A9z2ZwW1m6twE1IH2uBpc1fhPk2-CfV2pHiYwvTGmpXHrJ1A9alBODZPoFEYq3BY6H2sMDhNj_d5ycdS6fDTR3pnPKsx_AbOAGVeX6FnbPb-wgPkjMZWEHHLCKGCO4SL5OD0yVQFzKJjk700m2jMH5FyqXCkGukj6ghtLTxhlJPRUqrzjRYkFzE2x_nyGGEMdRtGpd6u3G_8h5WXhJwAA__98hoZj) in Kuwait, while American forces conducted limited retaliatory strikes. Trump dismissed Iran's negotiating position, saying the regime is "negotiating on fumes." The conflicting signals -- strikes and diplomacy unfolding simultaneously -- underscore how fragile any deal remains. Both governments face domestic pressure to show strength, and [negotiators acknowledge](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD3OpDAQRE8DmZHd5m8DB5uQzaYbosZuZlpjDLKbQXv7FXOEL61XKpXe38f8QI6cnn9wI5dlncMeZsnndlycysLP7cs_u3B6-hk09Ep3CsY5xdnUwQUf0PianBlGrQ20pq1f7tdAelwNEi4LgA96Nd50lmDwSw821OzuKd3BCLaz1jY0rN0IukMD2ut-rFqNkbI0mY5ziewxCZb3umdPjd-3OrqXyFEq-7uCqYLpuq4mLT7RVW5-J3uOoYKJM6YKprOojSML5n_KY85MRUXeWCgoFEH_VndTnUVJxkCqSOY3lTq7cFwcI5d-qFr9VfK9ID8w9nHwPwAA__8Snn23) that leaders on both sides have not yet endorsed the outline. ★★★
Mail-In Order Survives Court

A federal judge in Washington on Thursday [declined to block](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD1u8zAMQE9jbwr0a-sbNHxLtnTtaCgUkxCVJUOm4x6_sHuDjuQDSLz3eZtukTKV50ecMTR-TKmmids2LzuV9U7P-eTvylSeMGmpByGd0H4qeVJ9CglSVNBjUKOXUmmrbP8KoxoAR-dsHKz5h2gHMN57d3fn2vUUjlPSaa-NM8ZccHw4r6WLSkuQg--sjBkbXxou2z0TxMJx_XrUBniBOvc5vJiXtTP_O33t9DUuBff1QMfQmCBjp6-ni8CMwFTLKg4f8asj8BthY3qjqC1hE1C3xn0LadkpZ1qHsbPyLHB-5D8Eegf9EwAA__8hb3b8) President Trump's executive order restricting mail-in voting, handing the administration a significant legal win heading into the 2026 midterms. Democrats had sought an emergency injunction. The order directs the creation of a national voter eligibility list and limits who qualifies for a mail ballot. The judge found that plaintiffs could not yet [demonstrate irreparable harm](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGOhCAURb8GOybwFMWCYhu72XZLg4DjyyIYeM78_kY_YeuT3Jtzfp7z02LE9Pq2ezCF1tlnP1M59-ODqS742m_-zoTp5WYQ0HOhOOg5xVk23njnrXRNMHLQQkjoZNdsRg4g9NIGLXulxlVZIYXvnYYhrAqcbtBcU0KBhla1bfsIw6o0CGUlCCd6zTphYyj0KOE4l4jOJrL1d83FhYfLexPNRnRU1n4xmBhMtIUNY7wYg2nLe0jhUxlM1u-YsFKxhDkxmJQe9Thq7vJZiJfz8ue3M79sOSa-2BgzMZiaYvzxwRix9gPrxN3j_qd_5Hob-AsAAP__3SN6BQ) -- a threshold required for emergency relief -- leaving the order in place for now. The ruling does not resolve the underlying constitutional questions, and legal challenges are expected to continue. But the decision gives the administration [time to implement](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGupSAURb8GOwwcELkFxTR2d9opDcLRywyCQdT5_Bd9f_Dqlezstf68x7cNMaTlt13RlDqPPvuxlmPdrpD2KSzrw89cQ1rcCAwUZR0FPaY48sYb77zlrkHDe80YB8ll8zH2NQvtdDcJ5LKXrJ-VctMs_GuSXinbBHNPsQ40iE4I0WI_dxpYZzkwx5QmktmIpbYFt2OKwdlU7f5vzsVh6_LaRPOpdduJ-EVgIDBc19UWPCqW_eYEhoiLjQSGJZ9Y0oqpEhj-Hn5BamPM104fURrWLeKN6S1LQ6LfuhT_oztqOJHm4rEQGJpi_HaFGMOueiLZk-e5U39Q7zTwFQAA__8AJ4IH) the order before November, a window that could reshape how millions of Americans vote. ★★★
GOP Wins Redistricting War

Republicans are on track to finish the 2026 redistricting cycle with a structural advantage of roughly 10 House seats over Democrats, according to a [CNN analysis published Thursday](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGOszAQBp_GdKBljYMpXPwNXf72SuTYS7I62yDbCa9_gub661YaabTffN2Xu-XA6fnfRjK5rovf_FLzO-4Hp_LgZ7z4Z6ucnm5BwFsLqkW9pLD0jTfeedu7hkw_aoAeh35oXmaiCawGIDsNMEwj0mOV44RWrVpLoobNqQKFGqWSUnY0rkojKNsjOLhpMYANlGuXaX8_Ajubqi3f65YddW6LTTCvWvci5D-Bs8D5OI7OpXQygfNpFziDOm8tcN63wJVdETj_Gksb2VfKsc3kudTM7tzZHja3nuLmsq2lycbvB4fA5TaKAa4k1wv1D8U-Bn8CAAD__wjQeu0). The coast-to-coast map-drawing battle -- driven by mid-decade redistricting pushed by the White House -- is nearing its conclusion. The cycle has reshuffled millions of voters into new districts across the country. [PBS NewsHour reported](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDFuxCAQRU-DOywYjNcuKNK427QpLQzYHgUDAna5frQb5QKp52n03_u6r3eNHsPxqS-nct1XG-1a8-NKDUPZ8Lje92esGA6zAoORMklhWoNfeWeVNVZz0znFbxNjHAY-dKcyMOpRsmmWXM9SAMx23hgXbneDNaPoUL1eMQkTCCmE6N1tlxMwqTkww8aJDEx7l2ufXXpsHo0OVZfvPWbjehOvzquz1lSI-CCwEFhaa33aSh_zQWAJrpUzPjKBJUWPFU0hsFxoq8sXzc5iqRnNy4qeutDktXGWXug9xlAoBhpco7_e9I8uXVY2tRdUxhsZ2DvPe079R72ngp8AAAD__4gAghE) that the scale of the remapping is unprecedented outside of a decennial census year, with several battleground states redrawing lines that had been in place since 2022. Not every fight is settled. Alabama Republicans asked the Supreme Court to lift a lower-court ruling blocking their preferred map -- a move that [could add another seat](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLuOwyAQRb8Gd1jD4FcKim3cZdstrTGPBAUbC3D4_ZWzf7DdSDOae8_5uS938sHvj2_arErFLSaapaRzO6rf8-of22f_jsXvD70g4MCh5zgte1hEY5TRhoRurBLjBCCwE13zVJN1jkY3SBxoFW61Ug6ocRXkEAGg8ep6BT1OKHspZWtH108IPQkEDcPEOqBgU2mTPc41eE17ofxyMWnb6rg1QT1LOTKTXwxnhnOttT1i8MXreB0wnHdbM8P5SmI4Q3_NI8OZAq20Eaf8yjyfR7Kb5TqeqfASOYUQK0_W-FyS1xc4dzHxP3a4yam7dU1S5qg-BJ-HkXXw8fTpVf6h8a3wNwAA__88soBu) to the GOP column. The structural edge, however, is already baked in.

Trump Defies Midterm Pressure on Iran

Trump dismissed midterm pressure to soften his Iran war strategy at a [cabinet meeting](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD2OrDAQBk9jMqN2GwMTOHgJ2bx0Q-SfhrHWNsh4hj3-Co6wWUst1aeqr-f8NCGGvP43iXSpy-w3P9fyTvsZ8mHDmu7_Z6shr25GwJ6D4jjOOc6i8do7b4RrSIthBBDYia55aSCSFqSxD-nkg4xQ0I8kpF2sUSihCfpCgcIRpZJStjQsakRQRiA46EfWgYlUaltof9sYnMnVHN_LVhy1bktN1K9a94PJfwwnhtN5nm3eS7uVleF00RlOoK57YDjlH34IrkbZIyDD6XbkztiQqfJEdAnyUEzmKfhKJR1N0X4_Q4zh6AfWwd3i3q5_SPXR-BsAAP__yDx2Fg) on Wednesday, calling Tehran "negotiating on fumes." Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Vice President JD Vance are statistically tied for the 2028 Republican nomination, per a [new Emerson poll](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGO6yAQRb_G7ohgMIYUFK9Jl9duaWEYJ6NgQEBi7d-vkmb7rY90ru75ui5XR5HS7b_b0da-LSGHpdfnXg5KbaXb_uGv3Cnd_AIcZsYVA7OkuIgx2OCDE35EK7ThXMAkpvFuJW5rmLya5wkRAj-L9QybNqvSUnstRrJvFVdgQCop5Qn1pgxw5QRwz2czTNxFrP1UsTzXSN6l7tpjy9Xjyed9jPbee2mD_DfAZYBLwqMdiI83HOCyu-ozq8-VMgMOhv16WKnYKGDq5CIrlXZXv1nJMTIxVhvKQTFSm_Uw8c__z17_Q56XhZ8AAAD__1UudcU), with Rubio's Iran diplomacy fueling his surge.
